kyoto_shozankaku_matsuyama_isetan.gf_detail: Ask: Tabelog says allergy information is available; yuba and soy milk are naturally wheat-free, but yuba tempura, fu and ponzu are on the courses (2026 reviews).
kyoto_shozankaku_matsuyama_isetan.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi throughout; sashimi, fish, shrimp and conger eel in the courses (2026 reviews).
kyoto_shozankaku_matsuyama_isetan.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 11:00–22:00 (last order 21:15); closed on JR Kyoto Isetan's closing days. Reservations taken (private rooms by phone); seating about 2 hours. No service charge — Tabelog, Japanese original 「無」. 42 seats; private rooms for 8 and for 10–20; non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; English menu with photos; allergy information available; children welcome with a kids' menu. Cards (Visa, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay); no e-money or QR. On the 11th floor of JR Kyoto Isetan, with views of Kyoto Tower and the mountains (2026 reviews).
kyoto_shozankaku_matsuyama_isetan.notes: [Yuba kaiseki · Kyoto Station Isetan 11F, warm yuba in a tub] The station branch of a Kyoto yuba-cuisine house: warm, freshly made yuba scooped from a wooden tub with ponzu, yuba sashimi and tempura, and seasonal courses, with a view toward Kyoto Tower — convenient before a train. Diners in 2026 praise the yuba; some found the service stiff or harried (September and October 2026) and one found the seasoning salty (October 2026). No service charge.

roles: Not named in a source; branch of the yuba-cuisine house 松山閣 松山, whose main restaurant is elsewhere in Kyoto (Gurunavi)
chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe a calm restaurant on the department-store restaurant floor with views of the mountains and Kyoto Tower, kimono-clad servers, rice crackers and hot water on arrival, and yuba that a September 2026 diner was told is made at a shop near Kinkaku-ji.
chef_bio.specialty: Homemade yuba in a wooden tub (yuba-oke).

anecdotes.text: September 2026: "the service felt a bit disorganized, possibly due to being busy. The staff could have been a bit more friendly."
October 2026: "I found the saltiness to be quite pronounced, despite the presentation" — and the "matsutake rice" turned out to be mushroom rice.
October 2026: "the signature homemade yuba bucket was exquisite; I almost drank all the soy milk without realizing it."
October 2026: "the service from the most experienced-looking woman in a kimono was a bit intimidating."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京料理・本家生ゆば料理 松山閣 松山 JR京都伊勢丹店、日本料理・豆腐料理、下京区烏丸通塩小路下る東塩小路町901 ジェイアール京都伊勢丹 11F、JR京都駅から徒歩1分、毎日 11:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:15)、休みはJR京都伊勢丹に準じる、予約可 (個室は電話で)、利用は2時間ほど、原文でサービス料「無」、42席、個室 (8名、10〜20名)、禁煙、車椅子可、英語と写真のメニュー、アレルギー表示あり、子供可・子供メニュー、カード可、電子マネー・QR不可。口コミ (2026年8〜10月、英語): 自家製の湯葉桶をポン酢で、豆乳、湯葉刺し、湯葉の天ぷら、豆腐の味噌田楽、季節の京弁当4,070円 (湯葉桶付き、きのこご飯はおかわり可、湯葉バウムクーヘン)、「Miyabi」コース5,500円、「Sakae」の会席 (松茸の土瓶蒸し、鰆の幽庵焼き、蓮根饅頭)、京都タワーや山の眺め、湯葉は金閣寺の近くの店で作るとの説明、サービスが慌ただしいという声、塩気が強いという声、年長の着物の女性の接客が怖かったという声。

kyoto_miki_keiran_nishiki.gf_detail: Ask: the dashimaki dashi is kombu with urume, soda-katsuo and mackerel flakes (official site), but soy seasoning is not stated; the sandwiches, buns and cream puffs are wheat.
kyoto_miki_keiran_nishiki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: egg dishes in a fish dashi (official site).
kyoto_miki_keiran_nishiki.hours_raw: Official site and Tabelog: 9:00–17:00 daily; closed only at New Year. Take-away counter with a small standing eat-in space and a bin; staff will cut a dashimaki for eating on the spot (2024–2025 reviews). No reservations. Tabelog lists no cards, e-money or QR, but a March 2026 diner paid with PayPay. Popular items (pudding) sell out; a sold-out dashimaki can be made fresh if you wait (October 2025).
kyoto_miki_keiran_nishiki.notes: [Dashimaki · Nishiki Market, since 1928] A Nishiki Market egg shop since 1928 where craftsmen hand-roll dashi-heavy dashimaki in custom copper pans: buy a small roll to eat at the stand, a green-onion or eel roll, or the dashimaki sandwich and pudding. One diner expected it hot and got it cold (September 2026). Open daily 9:00–17:00.

roles: Not named in a source; Miki Keiran Co., Ltd. (official site)
chef_bio.background: Founded in Showa 3 (1928), with its main shop near the middle of Nishiki Market (official site). The dashi uses Nishiki well water and Rishiri kombu simmered slowly, with urume, soda-katsuo and mackerel flakes; every roll is still hand-cooked, rolled front to back in the "Kyo-maki" style over high heat in long, heavy copper pans made to order by Aritsugu, a craftsman working three pans at once (official site). Counters at Takashimaya Kyoto and JR Kyoto Isetan, and a bakery of egg breads and sweets, mikikeirando (official site).
chef_bio.philosophy: From its site: "創業以来、伝承の技法で変わらぬ味を守っています" (since its founding, keeping the same taste with handed-down techniques).

anecdotes.text: January 2024: in a Nishiki now full of bar-like eateries, "the traditional ambiance still remains at a place called Miki Keiran."
May 2024: "If you want to eat it now, I'll cut the dashimaki for you," said the staff — "They even gave me three chopsticks."
September 2026: "I expected it to be freshly made, but it was cold, which was a bit disappointing."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 昭和三年創業のだし巻玉子専門店、錦市場のほぼ真ん中に本店、錦の井戸水と利尻昆布、うるめ節・宗田鰹・さば節の出汁、職人が一本ずつ手焼き、有次の特注の銅の玉子焼鍋、手前から奥へ巻く「京巻き」、三本の鍋を同時に使う、だし巻 (小690円・中1,050円・大1,700円・特上1,950円)、九条ねぎ巻1,190円、かやく巻1,600円、う巻2,800円、ふくさ焼580円、錦本店は9:00〜17:00で年始以外無休、高島屋京都店とJR京都伊勢丹店、パンと菓子の三木鶏卵堂 (mikikeirando)。食べログ: 三木鶏卵、日本料理・パン、中京区錦小路通富小路西入東魚屋町182、予約不可、持ち帰り、カード・電子マネー・QR不可。口コミ (2024年1月〜2026年9月、英語): だし巻、九条ねぎ巻、う巻、だし巻サンド、黄身あんぱん、クリームパン、シュークリーム、瓶のプリン、店の前で立って食べられる、PayPayで払えたという声、冷めていたという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Take-away counter in Nishiki Market; small standing space.

existence.note: Official site lists the Nishiki main shop; Tabelog reviews through September 2026.

kyoto_koka_ryuho_rihga.gf_detail: Ask. Cantonese courses of dim sum, sauces with soy and bean paste, fried rice and noodles; staff help tailor orders (2023–2025 reviews).
kyoto_koka_ryuho_rihga.vegan_detail: Not vegan: shark-fin soup, seafood, beef and chicken courses (2023–2025 reviews).
kyoto_koka_ryuho_rihga.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–15:30 (last order 14:30) and 17:00–21:30 (last order 20:00); irregular closing days, see the hotel website (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). A 10% service charge (Tabelog original サービス料10%). 78 seats with private rooms for 4 to over 30 (room fee); stroller-friendly (Tabelog; December 2023). À la carte in small or medium plates (December 2023). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). B1F of RIHGA Royal Hotel Kyoto; hotel parking free for 3 hours with a ¥4,000 spend from 1 April 2026; 7 min walk west of Kyoto Station (Tabelog).
kyoto_koka_ryuho_rihga.notes: [Cantonese · RIHGA Royal Hotel Kyoto B1F] The hotel's calm Cantonese room near Kyoto Station: lunch courses of appetisers, shark-fin soup, dim sum, XO-steamed sea bream and seafood fried rice, à la carte in small portions, and private rooms often used for family gatherings and memorials. Attentive service; one 2024 dinner guest found it merely average. Plus 10% service. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: the Chinese restaurant of RIHGA Royal Hotel Kyoto, with dim sum and private rooms; registered as an official listing by the operator. An October 2025 reviewer recalls the building was once the Kyoto Grand Hotel.

anecdotes.text: For the hotel's 55th-anniversary lunch in December 2024, staff set the table to match what the guest had mentioned when booking.
After a memorial service in November 2025, a family gathered in a private room here around the late uncle's portrait.
An October 2023 diner could not find any shark fin in the shark-fin soup, but still found it very good.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 中華料理・飲茶、下京区東堀川通り塩小路下ル松明町1 リーガロイヤルホテル京都 B1F、JR京都駅から西へ徒歩約7分、毎日 11:30〜15:30 (L.O.14:30)・17:00〜21:30 (L.O.20:00)、不定休、予約可、サービス料10%、78席、個室 (4名〜30名以上、別料金)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2026年4月1日から4,000円以上の利用でホテルの駐車場3時間無料。口コミ (2023年4月〜2025年11月、英語): 広東料理、「Kofuku」ランチ (前菜、ふかひれスープ、点心、XO 醤の鯛の蒸し物、牛肉の甜麺醤炒めとクレープ、海鮮のあんかけチャーハン、デザート)、カジュアルランチ (帆立の蒸し物、朝天唐辛子の鶏)、海老チリ2種、蟹入りのふかひれスープ、小皿と中皿のアラカルト、ベビーカーで個室へ、ホテル55周年のランチ、法事のあとの会食、平凡との声 (2024年8月)、昔の京都グランドホテル。

kyoto_cantina_rossi_demachi.gf_detail: Not GF: handmade fresh pasta is the heart of every course, with crostini, cutlets and tiramisu (2021–2026 reviews).
kyoto_cantina_rossi_demachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cream and Gorgonzola pastas, nduja, lamb and beef cutlets, cheese and ham (2021–2026 reviews).
kyoto_cantina_rossi_demachi.hours_raw: Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday 12:00–14:30 and 18:00–21:30; Monday, Wednesday and Friday 18:00–21:30; closed Sunday; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and advised — about three groups fit at once (Tabelog; February 2024, August 2026). No e-money or QR (Tabelog). 10 seats; non-smoking (Tabelog). An iron sculpture marks the door, down a narrow residential lane; 7 min walk from Demachiyanagi Stn (Tabelog; February 2024).
kyoto_cantina_rossi_demachi.notes: [Italian · Demachiyanagi back lane, couple-run] A ten-seat Italian tucked in a residential lane behind an iron sculpture, run by a friendly couple: handmade pastas such as Gorgonzola cream or Amatriciana, crostini, lamb or beef cutlet, tiramisu and Italian wine, at prices reviewers call remarkable — lunch from ¥2,670, a dinner omakase near ¥4,800. Pastas can be split to share. Book; closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an Italian restaurant near Demachiyanagi with a website at cantinarossi.com. Reviewers describe a couple running the ground floor of a house in a residential area (June 2024; April 2025), and say it was listed as a Michelin Bib Gourmand in 2021 and 2022 (September 2021; March 2022).

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 pair, waiting outside before noon, were waved in three minutes early with a "Please come in".
A September 2021 diner who mentioned a birthday found a surprise on the plate.
A January 2026 couple, the only guests that evening, had the pasta served divided onto two plates.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリアン、左京区吉田泉殿町57-1、京阪出町柳駅から徒歩7分、火・木・土 12:00〜14:30・18:00〜21:30、月・水・金 18:00〜21:30、日曜定休、予約可、電子マネー・QR 不可、10席、禁煙。口コミ (2021年9月〜2026年8月、英語): 住宅街の路地、鉄のオブジェ、家の1階、夫婦で営む、3組ほどで満席、ランチ PRANZO 2,670円から (クロスティーニ3種、5〜6種から選ぶパスタ、ドリンク)、野菜の前菜の盛り合わせ1,300円、生パスタ (ゴルゴンゾーラのクリーム、アマトリチャーナ、ンドゥイヤのトマトクリーム、きのことレモンのタリアテッレ、茄子とトマト)、取り分けて半量ずつ、夜のおまかせ4,800円台 (パン、前菜、パスタ2種、羊や牛のカツレツ、デザート、ドリンク)、ティラミス、イタリアワイン、ミシュランのビブグルマン (2021年・2022年) との声、誕生日のサプライズ。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead (10 seats); pasta can be split to share; no e-money or QR.

kyoto_kyo_yoshoku_matsumoto.gf_detail: Not GF: demi-glace hamburg, omurice with hayashi or demi-glace, tonkatsu and beef cutlet (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kyo_yoshoku_matsumoto.vegan_detail: Not vegan: hamburg, ginger pork, steak, cutlets and pork miso soup (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kyo_yoshoku_matsumoto.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday 11:30–15:00 (last entry 14:15) and 18:00–22:00 (last entry 21:00); closed Monday (open on holiday Mondays, closed the next Tuesday) plus further posted days — in November 2026 the 2nd, 9th, 10th, 16th, 24th and 30th (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; tatami seats by phone request; change times by phone (Tabelog). At dinner, a ¥500 charge if you do not order food (Tabelog original ディナー時間帯は食事をされない場合はチャージ料￥５００). 37 seats: 9 at the counter and 28 at tables incl. 8 on tatami; private room (Tabelog). Cards; PayPay per a July 2026 review (Tabelog; July 2026). A machiya with a Jizo shrine; 8 min walk from Karasuma or Shijo stations (Tabelog).
kyoto_kyo_yoshoku_matsumoto.notes: [Yoshoku · machiya west of Shijo Karasuma, Kyoto vegetables] A calm machiya with a Jizo shrine serving yoshoku built around Kyoto produce: demi-glace or tomato hamburg, caper-sauced ginger pork, beef cutlet and a soufflé omurice, each with a heap of grilled vegetables and pork miso soup. Some find the flavours unusual — one guest tasted liver in the hamburg. Book; closed Monday and posted days.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a machiya-style yoshoku restaurant with a Jizo shrine, using Kyoto vegetables and meats; registered as an official listing by the shop, which offers message plates with dessert by phone request. Reviewers in 2026 describe a popular, calm restaurant with reservations streaming in at opening (October 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Kyoto vegetables and meats in yoshoku (October 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 diner found pink peppercorns piled on the salad and a hamburg tasting strongly of liver, almost like pâté.
An October 2026 mother and daughter, put off the hamburg by reviews mentioning liver, chose the demi-glace omurice and loved it.
A fourth-visit regular in August 2026 always orders the adult hamburg with tomato sauce.

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; phone for tatami or time changes; ¥500 charge at dinner without food; cards.

kyoto_beer_restaurant_munchen.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fried chicken, pork cutlet, sausages, roast beef and smoked salmon (2026 reviews).
kyoto_beer_restaurant_munchen.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–23:00 (last order 22:00), open straight through (Tabelog; August 2026). Cards, e-money and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). In the first lane east off Kawaramachi north of Shijo; 3 min walk from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_beer_restaurant_munchen.notes: [Beer hall · Shijo Kawaramachi lane, open all day] A big, old-school beer restaurant just off Kawaramachi, open from 11:30 straight to 23:00: brewery-fresh draught in sizes up to a litre, Hoegaarden on tap, a famous crisp kara-age of chicken breast, demi-glace tonkatsu sets at lunch and a ¥1,250 beer-and-two-plates afternoon set. Families at lunch, parties at night. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a beer hall serving nostalgic yoshoku with freshly brewed beer delivered from the brewery; registered as an official listing by the operator. Our crawls also list ビヤレストラン ハウスミュンヘン at the same address.
chef_bio.philosophy: Nostalgic yoshoku with brewery-fresh beer (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 regular on a sixth visit had the tonkatsu set — "It's a shame I can't drink beer, though," noted on an earlier visit in May.
An October 2026 group booked at 17:00 the day before and stayed four hours over a one-litre mug.
An October 2026 wedding party found it one of the few places open for drinks at 14:30 on a Sunday.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ビアホール・洋食・唐揚げ、中京区河原町通四条上ル一筋目東入ル、阪急河原町駅から徒歩3分、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、毎日 11:30〜23:00 (L.O.22:00)、予約可 (宴会コースは4名以上・前日まで、11名以上は電話で)、289席 (1階 66席と立ち飲み23、2階200席)、個室、禁煙、車椅子可、カラオケ、プロジェクター、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、醸造所直送の生ビールと懐かしい洋食。口コミ (2026年5月〜10月、英語): ビールのサイズが豊富 (1L のジョッキも)、ヒューガルデンの生、ピッチャー、黒とハーフ&ハーフ、名物の胸肉の唐揚げ、とんかつ定食1,250円 (デミグラス)、プレーンオムレツの定食1,050円、「quick drink」のセット1,250円 (ビールと2品)、ソーセージの盛り合わせ、フライドポテト、ポップコーン、飲み放題の宴会コース、昼から夜まで通し営業、家族連れも。

cultural_comfort.note: Big hall, easy to walk in; banquet courses by the day before; cards, IC and QR.

kyoto_fromagerie_harmonie.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a cheese shop and cheesecake café (Tabelog).

kyoto_fromagerie_harmonie.notes: [Cheese shop & cheesecake · Okazaki] A tiny basement cheese shop off Nijo-dori with eight counter seats: six rich cheesecakes — try the Gorgonzola or ricotta — with Ronnefeldt tea for ¥1,100, and cheeses to take away. Handy after the museums. Closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog and reviewers: one of the few cheese specialists in Kyoto, with a cheesecake counter in the basement.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 visitor was told a ricotta cheesecake and cream orange tea "work well together" — and found the pairing worked.
Finding the eight seats full in September 2025, a visitor was about to leave when someone vacated a seat.

kyoto_imaya_coffee.vegan_detail: Not vegan: breakfast with egg, chicken, cheese and yogurt; milk coffees (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_imaya_coffee.hours_raw: Mon–Fri 6:00–13:00 and 16:00–20:00; Sat–Sun 6:00–13:00; hours may change (Tabelog). Bookings taken (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay (Tabelog). 15 seats with counter and sofas; non-smoking (Tabelog). Some staff speak English (November 2025 review). The café of the IMAYA guesthouse, in a renovated machiya near Okine Shrine; 5 min from Karasuma Oike Stn, near Nijojo-mae (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_imaya_coffee.notes: [Neapolitan café · near Oike] A bright machiya café attached to a guesthouse, open from 6:00: a creamy cappuccino reviewers call the best ever, a hot-sandwich breakfast (about ¥1,000), fresh orange juice and Neapolitan craft beer. Popular with Italian and other foreign visitors; English spoken.

roles: Owner (unnamed), who also runs a guesthouse
chef_bio.background: A June 2026 reviewer says the owner, passionate about coffee, also runs a guesthouse; an August 2026 regular of four years says the café was featured in the southern Italian paper Il Mattino and on Italian media, and draws ever more Italian visitors.

anecdotes.text: A couple who loved this coffee in Naples came in July 2026 on a friend's tip and found the room full of the city's atmosphere.
A September 2026 guest who dislikes soft-boiled eggs had the egg cooked through on request.

kyoto_all_day_dining_rajou.gf_detail: Ask. A buffet of Japanese, Western and Chinese dishes, grilled meats and desserts; dish labelling not described (2026 reviews).
kyoto_all_day_dining_rajou.vegan_detail: Ask. Salads and vegetables among many meat, fish and dairy dishes (2026 reviews).
kyoto_all_day_dining_rajou.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 daily; dinner 17:30–21:30 on weekdays, 17:30–21:00 at weekends and holidays (Tabelog); a breakfast buffet also runs (September 2026 review). Bookings taken; 100% cancellation charge from two days before (Tabelog). Service charge: 15% — Tabelog's Japanese original says 「サービス料15%※2025年4月1日のご利用よりサービス料をご利用額（税抜）の15%に改定させていただきます。」. Cards, IC cards and QR (Tabelog). 90 seats under a six-storey atrium; non-smoking; parking 50 cars, ¥800 per 30 min with restaurant benefits (Tabelog). 2F of the Kyoto Century Hotel, 2 min east of Kyoto Station's central gate (Tabelog).
kyoto_all_day_dining_rajou.notes: [Hotel buffet · Kyoto Century Hotel by Kyoto Station] The hotel's bright atrium restaurant, two minutes from the station: a theatre-style buffet whose live kitchen rotates wagyu roast beef and other meats every half hour, plus breakfast and seasonal sweets buffets. Dinner about ¥6,000–9,000 before the 15% service charge.

roles: Restaurant of the Kyoto Century Hotel (no person named)
chef_bio.background: Opened 11 August 2012 (Tabelog), in the Kyoto Century Hotel of Keihan Hotels & Resorts (official site). A long-time regular notes a significant renovation in 2026 (September 2026 review).
chef_bio.specialty: Theatre-style buffet with live meat kitchen.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 guest found the buffet tasty but narrow for a hotel, with meats ordered and grilled in turns so one could not eat much, and the value not great.
A September 2026 lunch guest found the all-you-can-drink service a little slow.
Before an October 2026 Shinkansen, a visitor enjoyed the weekday lunch with well-spaced tables.

kyoto_blend_kyoto.gf_detail: Ask. A coffee stand; no food or gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_blend_kyoto.vegan_detail: Ask. Black coffee is plant-based; ask about milk drinks (reviews).
kyoto_blend_kyoto.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday 12:00–17:00; Saturday, Sunday and holidays 9:00–17:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 2 seats — mostly a stand; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). On Takeyamachi-dori east of Fuyacho, on the way to the Imperial Palace grounds, 578 m from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; October 2025).
kyoto_blend_kyoto.notes: [Coffee · Takeyamachi, blend your own cup] A tiny, stylish specialty-coffee stand on the way to the Imperial Palace grounds, run by a barista from Tokyo's GLITCH COFFEE & ROASTERS. Sniff your way through jars of light-roast beans labelled a to i, choose two, and the barista blends and brews your cup — about ¥1,200 a cup. Just two seats, so plan to stroll with it. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per an April 2026 review: the owner trained at the renowned GLITCH COFFEE & ROASTERS in Tokyo before opening this shop in Kyoto. Reviewers describe a wide choice of light-roast beans from which guests pick two for a custom blend.

anecdotes.text: A July 2026 visitor chose beans by smelling jars labelled a through i.
A November 2025 regular rates it a top pick in Kyoto for light-roast specialty coffee.
A March 2026 visitor found it busy and tried a cinnamon-flavoured coffee.

kyoto_beer_lab.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a brewpub of malt beers, with fried snacks (2026 reviews).
kyoto_beer_lab.vegan_detail: Ask. Snacks such as edamame and fries alongside kara-age and salmon jerky; nothing vegan is marked (2026 reviews).
kyoto_beer_lab.hours_raw: 13:00–23:00 daily; hours may change (Tabelog). Order and pay at the counter after taking a seat (June 2026). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 15 seats; non-smoking; JCB, AMEX, Diners, transit IC and QR (Tabelog). Beside the Takase River, 245 m from Shichijo Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened 30 March 2018; first batch and grand opening 27 April 2018 (Tabelog).
kyoto_beer_lab.notes: [Craft beer · Shichijo, a brewpub by the Takase River] A small brewery-bar beside the Takase River near Shichijo, pouring its own beers — from a Yakima Valley IPA to Kyoto-tea brews like hōjicha stout and kabusecha white ale — by the half (about ¥700–800) or pint (about ¥1,100–1,200). Order at the counter, sit by the water, add kara-age or fried cheese. Open daily 13:00–23:00.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: opened 30 March 2018, with its first batch and grand opening on 27 April 2018. Reviewers describe a brewpub by the Takase River with a long rotating list of house beers, including Kyoto green-tea styles.
chef_bio.specialty: House beers including hōjicha stout and kabusecha white ale.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 visitor arrived on the anniversary and found about eight special beers on tap.
A March 2026 guest came straight from the sauna at Ume-yu nearby.
A May 2026 regular on a tenth visit dropped in just before 22:00 on a Friday.

kyoto_sogen_cafe.gf_detail: Ask. Curries with rice, carrot cake, parfaits and pudding; no gluten information is published (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sogen_cafe.vegan_detail: Ask. Chicken and pork curries and dairy sweets; nothing vegan is marked (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sogen_cafe.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 11:00–17:00 (last order 16:30); closed Saturday, Sunday and holidays (official site; Tabelog). Online reservations taken (March 2026). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 20 seats: 8 at the counter, 12 at tables; non-smoking; no pets; cards and PayPay (Tabelog). On Shirakawa-dori in Kitashirakawa, across from Kyoto University of the Arts, 657 m from Chayama Stn (Tabelog; 2025 reviews). Opened 1 August 2005 (Tabelog); run by the Kyoto antiques and design business SOWGEN, whose Shijo café has merged into this one (official site).
kyoto_sogen_cafe.notes: [Café · Kitashirakawa, curry and parfaits among old furniture] A leafy, quietly stylish café run by the antiques shop SOWGEN, opposite Kyoto University of the Arts on Shirakawa-dori. Lunch is a gentle, vegetable-rich curry — the combination plate is about ¥1,200 — and the sweets are worth the trip: carrot cake, pudding à la mode (¥990) and small parfaits. Weekdays only; online bookings taken.

roles: Run by SOWGEN (antiques, plants and design); staff not named
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: SOWGEN deals in antiques, brocante, plants and interior design; そうげんカフェ is its Kitashirakawa café, which absorbed the café of its Shijo shop. Tabelog gives the opening as 1 August 2005; a June 2025 reviewer calls it a local staple of more than 15 years.
chef_bio.specialty: Combination curry; pudding à la mode.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 guest who arrived just after last order was still welcomed in.
A December 2025 diner had long missed it because it opens only on weekdays, and named it a favourite café of the year.
A June 2025 visitor came after being turned away from a nearby ramen shop and stayed for the curry.

kyoto_sumizo_yakiniku.gf_detail: Ask. Wagyu yakiniku with sweet-savoury marinades and tare; no gluten information is published (reviews).
kyoto_sumizo_yakiniku.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a wagyu yakiniku house (reviews).
kyoto_sumizo_yakiniku.hours_raw: 17:30–22:00, Monday, Friday, Saturday and Sunday; closed Tuesday–Thursday; hours may change (Tabelog). Bookings recommended. JCB, AMEX and Diners; no e-money (Tabelog). No service charge listed (Tabelog). In a residential street off Aburanokoji north of Nakadachiuri, easy to miss; about 13 min from Imadegawa Stn (742 m) and near Hotel Brighton Kyoto (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_sumizo_yakiniku.notes: [Yakiniku · Nishijin-south, a neighbourhood wagyu house] A well-loved yakiniku shop tucked in a residential street west of the Imperial Palace, where the friendly owner talks you through the cuts. Try the thick-cut harami and marinated horumon, wagyu tongue, and ask about the off-menu chateaubriand; a chirimen rice bowl rounds things off. Most spend ¥6,000–10,000. Open only Monday and Friday to Sunday evenings.

chef_bio.background: Per 2024–2026 reviews: a long-regarded yakiniku restaurant in the Imadegawa area known for fresh Kuroge wagyu, a generous owner full of grilling tips, and an off-menu chateaubriand.

anecdotes.text: A February 2025 diner who arrived around 20:00 found it quiet and got plenty of tips from the generous owner.
A November 2025 guest rated the cubed fillet steak in the Kuroge wagyu platter beyond expectations.
An August 2026 visitor staying at a nearby hotel struggled to find the hidden entrance.

kyoto_yuba_kameya_honke.gf_detail: Ask. Yuba and tofu kaiseki served with soy sauce, nama-fu (wheat gluten), shojin tempura and yuba-and-shrimp spring rolls; no gluten information (official menu; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_yuba_kameya_honke.vegan_detail: Some vegan options: the shojin kaiseki “Rokujo” (¥5,000 plus tax) is made without fish, shrimp, crab, meat, shellfish, egg, dairy, green onion, garlic, nira, rakkyo, onion or fish dashi, per the official menu. The yuba kaiseki courses include yuba-and-shrimp spring rolls. Book the Rokujo course ahead.
kyoto_yuba_kameya_honke.hours_raw: Dinner 17:00–21:30 (food L.O. 20:00, drinks 20:30), Tuesday–Saturday; Sunday 17:00–21:00; closed Monday; lunch on Saturdays and Sundays by reservation made the day before (Tabelog). Reservation only; parties of six or more by enquiry; cancellation policy applies (Tabelog). Strollers and wheelchairs are not allowed; the dining room is upstairs (Tabelog; August 2025). Cards and e-money (Tabelog). 26 seats at tables with screens; private rooms; no smoking inside or in front (Tabelog; official site). Shoes off at the entrance (November 2025). Three doors from Hankyu Omiya Stn exit 1, 2 min from Randen Shijo-Omiya Stn (Tabelog). A yuba restaurant since the Taisho era (March 2026 review).
kyoto_yuba_kameya_honke.notes: [Yuba · Shijo-Omiya, a Taisho-era yuba house with a vegan course] An old townhouse yuba restaurant by Hankyu Omiya Station: fresh yuba sashimi, dengaku, the soy-milk yuba hot pot, and a fully plant-based shojin kaiseki (no fish dashi, egg, dairy or alliums) for ¥5,000 plus tax. Reservation only; dining room upstairs, shoes off; no strollers or wheelchairs. Weekend lunch by advance booking.

chef_bio.background: A March 2026 reviewer calls it a long-established yuba restaurant dating from the Taisho era. Photos of Showa-era stars line the walls (November 2025). Reviewers describe friendly women staff (November 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Yuba hot pot; fresh yuba sashimi; shojin kaiseki.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 diner on the vegan “Rokujo” course was told the crispy fried yuba was made from the edges scooped up while making yuba.
A November 2025 guest was quizzed by the staff on how to read “hiryozu”.

kyoto_me_me_me_coffee.gf_detail: Not gluten-free as a menu: pancakes (including cornmeal pancakes, flour not stated), French toast, toast (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_me_me_me_coffee.vegan_detail: Not vegan: breakfast plates with bacon, eggs and dairy (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_me_me_me_coffee.hours_raw: 8:30–15:00 daily; irregular closures (Tabelog; hours may change). No reservations; order and pay at the register first (Tabelog; February 2026). Fills by mid-morning, waits of 15–20 minutes around 10:00 (November 2025; March 2026). Cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) and e-money; no QR (Tabelog). 16 seats with a counter; non-smoking (Tabelog). Original merchandise (August 2026). Down an alley near the Kamo River, 5 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; December 2025).
kyoto_me_me_me_coffee.notes: [Breakfast café · near the Kamo River at Marutamachi] A small retro, American-feeling café in an alley off the Kamo, open from 8:30 for pancake plates — cornmeal pancakes with bacon and eggs, French toast — and good coffee or chai. Order at the register; queues by 10:00. Some reviewers found the service brusque.

chef_bio.background: No owner is named in the sources read. Two 2026 reviewers found the service cold, one describing food and napkins being tossed onto the table (April 2026).

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 guest staying near Kyoto University walked along the Kamo River to breakfast and tried cornmeal pancakes for the first time.
A November 2025 visitor got in at 8:30 on a Sunday and watched it fill up right after.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ミーミーミー (ME ME ME)、カフェ・パン、上京区上生州町210、神宮丸太町駅から徒歩5分、毎日8:30〜15:00、不定休、予約不可、カード (JCB、AMEX、Diners)・電子マネー可、16席、禁煙。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 「ミーミーミー」と読む、アメリカ風の朝食カフェ、パンケーキのセット (ベーコン、目玉焼き、サラダ、果物、ドリンク) 1,800円、コーンミールのパンケーキ、フレンチトースト、トーストとコーヒーの朝食約1,400円、チャイラテ、先に会計、10時頃は待つ、接客が冷たいとの声も。

cultural_comfort.note: Order and pay at the register; busy mornings.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_shoku_to_mori.gf_detail: Ask. A single plate lunch that changes — sawara and vegetable tempura, tofu hamburg steak — plus pudding; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_shoku_to_mori.vegan_detail: Ask. Seasonal Kyoto-vegetable plate lunches, sometimes with a tofu hamburg, but most days include fish, and dashi and seasonings are not described (Tabelog shop text; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_shoku_to_mori.hours_raw: 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) daily, closing early when food runs out; irregular closures (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, including same-day; walk-ins wait for the second sitting (Tabelog; March and May 2026). One lunch menu, different on weekdays and holidays (September 2026). Cash only (Tabelog; September 2026). 20 seats on tatami and at low tables over two floors; shoes off; kotatsu-style chairs on request (Tabelog; May–June 2026). Children welcome (Tabelog). Down narrow alleys between Higashi Hongan-ji and Nishi Hongan-ji, about 13 min from Gojo Stn, 15 min from Kyoto Station (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Opened 8 June 2022 (Tabelog).
kyoto_shoku_to_mori.notes: [Plate lunch · between the Hongan-ji temples, a one-person machiya café] A 100-year-old townhouse café down narrow alleys, with tatami and low tables over two floors, where a single cook turns out one carefully made plate lunch a day — crisp sawara and vegetable tempura, a tofu hamburg — and a firm Showa-style pudding. Book (even same-day) to avoid waiting; slow but worth it. Cash only.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text describes dishes by an experienced chef in a converted Taisho-era townhouse. An April 2026 reviewer found the café “being managed by just one person”, cooking at the entrance kitchen; a February 2026 guest marvelled at one staff member covering both floors. A March 2026 reviewer wondered whether a couple runs it. A May 2026 guest found the building’s age and a restroom without a hand basin unsettling, though the food was outstanding.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 guest with leg trouble was seated on a kotatsu chair with a view of the courtyard.
An October 2026 holiday visitor waited about 30 minutes; the reviewer advises coming with time to spare.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 食と森、カフェ、下京区蛭子水町605、五条駅から徒歩13分、毎日11:30〜15:00 (L.O.14:30)、売り切れ次第終了、不定休、予約可、現金のみ、20席、座敷、子ども可、2022年6月8日オープン。店の紹介: 大正時代の町家を改装したカフェ、経験のある料理人の料理、京野菜の季節のプレートランチ。口コミ (2026年、英語): ランチは平日と休日でひとつずつ、鰆と野菜の天ぷら、豆腐ハンバーグのプレート、固めのプリン、ひとりで切り盛り、靴を脱いで座敷、待つこともある。

cultural_comfort.note: One set lunch; shoes off on tatami; cash only; reservations advised.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_murin_an_cafe.gf_detail: Ask. A tea-and-sweets set — matcha, dorayaki, monaka ice, dry sweets, Russian cakes from Murakami Kaishindo — none described for gluten (2026 reviews).
kyoto_murin_an_cafe.vegan_detail: Ask. Matcha and juices are plant-based; the sweets are not described (2026 reviews).
kyoto_murin_an_cafe.hours_raw: April–September 9:00–18:00, October–March 9:00–17:00; last entry 30 minutes before closing; reservations given priority (Tabelog). Garden admission ¥600 plus a café set ¥1,200 — any drink with any sweet; items are not sold singly (July–September 2026); entry and café can be booked together online (August 2026). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 20 seats, mostly tatami, facing the garden (Tabelog). Inside the garden villa of Yamagata Aritomo by Nanzen-ji, 7 min from Keage Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_murin_an_cafe.notes: [Garden café · Nanzen-ji, Yamagata Aritomo’s villa] Tea on the tatami of a Meiji-era villa looking over one of Kyoto’s great modern gardens, laid out by the seventh-generation Ogawa Jihei for Yamagata Aritomo. Pay the ¥600 garden entry, then a ¥1,200 set of matcha or juice with a sweet (dorayaki, monaka ice, Murakami Kaishindo Russian cake). Book ahead; open from 9:00.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s shop text: the villa was built for the politician Yamagata Aritomo between 1894 and 1896, and the garden was made by the seventh-generation Ogawa Jihei on Yamagata’s instructions. Reviewers note an explanation of the garden before tea (August and October 2026) and its role in pre–Russo-Japanese War diplomatic talks (August 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Matcha and sweets with the garden view.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 visitor booked a combined entry-and-café ticket online for a 17:00 slot.
A September 2026 visitor finally tried the Russian cakes of Murakami Kaishindo here, never having managed to visit the shop.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 無鄰菴、カフェ、左京区南禅寺草川町31、蹴上駅から徒歩約7分、4〜9月 9:00〜18:00、10〜3月 9:00〜17:00、最終入場は閉場30分前、予約優先、カード・電子マネー・QR可、20席。店の紹介: 明治27〜29年にYamagata Aritomo が造営した別荘、七代目 Ogawa Jihei が作庭した近代日本庭園の名作を眺めながら抹茶を。口コミ (2026年、英語・日本語): 入場料600円とカフェのセット1,200円 (飲み物と菓子を自由に組み合わせ、単品不可)、抹茶とどら焼き、最中アイス、白桃ジュース、干菓子、村上開新堂のロシアケーキ、京都ビアルームの室町セゾン、事前予約がよい。

cultural_comfort.note: Garden admission ¥600 plus a ¥1,200 café set; many overseas visitors (September 2026); book ahead.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_grand_burger_teramachi.gf_detail: Not GF: burgers on wheat buns, battered fish and chips, fries; pancakes on the menu (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_grand_burger_teramachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: beef patties, bacon, cheese, egg and battered fish (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_grand_burger_teramachi.hours_raw: Monday, Thursday and Friday 11:00–20:30; Tuesday, Saturday and Sunday 11:00–18:00; closed Wednesday; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations at lunch, but takeaway orders can be booked (Tabelog). Cards (JCB, AMEX) and e-money; no QR (Tabelog). 20 seats: 8 at the counter and 12 at tables; non-smoking (Tabelog). On the west side of Teramachi-dori, 50 m south of Imadegawa; a paid car park 30 m south; 7 min walk from Demachiyanagi or Imadegawa stations (Tabelog).
kyoto_grand_burger_teramachi.notes: [Burgers · Teramachi south of Imadegawa] A small burger café by the Imperial Palace side of Teramachi: thick, juicy handmade patties with bacon, cheese, plenty of avocado or a fried egg, fish and chips with tartare, and hot fries — a set comes to just under ¥2,000. Lightly seasoned, with no signature sauce; busy with takeaway and visitors from abroad. One February 2026 guest found it soggy and pricey. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a hamburger, café and pancake shop on Teramachi south of Imadegawa. Reviewers in 2025–2026 describe carefully handmade burgers, many takeaway orders and overseas visitors, and a small room that fills quickly.

anecdotes.text: On a holiday morning in June 2025 a guest craving "a carefully handmade burger" rather than fast food came at opening, and watched takeaway orders pile up by early afternoon.
An August 2026 burger fan called it one of the best ever, after a bacon cheeseburger with egg and fish and chips.
A July 2026 diner found meat juices pooled at the bottom of the bacon burger by the last bite.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ハンバーガー・カフェ・パンケーキ、上京区寺町通今出川下ル真如堂前町107 1F、出町柳駅から西へ徒歩7分、今出川駅から東へ徒歩7分、寺町今出川の交差点から南へ50m の西側、月・木・金 11:00〜20:30、火・土・日 11:00〜18:00、水曜定休、ランチの予約不可 (テイクアウトの予約は可)、カード (JCB・AMEX)・電子マネー可、QR 不可、20席 (カウンター8、テーブル12)、禁煙、30m 南に有料駐車場。口コミ (2025年6月〜2026年8月、英語): 手作りのハンバーガー、GRAND BURGER、ベーコンチーズバーガー、アボカドバーガー、アボカドと2種のチーズ、ベーコンバーガー、卵のトッピング、厚くジューシーなパティ、味付けは軽め、フィッシュ&チップスとタルタル、コールスロー、2種のポテト、セットで2,000円弱、テイクアウトと外国人客が多い、べちゃっとして割高との声 (2026年2月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Burger café popular with visitors; order at the counter; cards (JCB, AMEX) and e-money.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through August 2026.

kyoto_shunsai_tanaka_de_tanaka.gf_detail: Ask. Sashimi, obanzai, tempura, fried fish and somen with soy and dashi; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_shunsai_tanaka_de_tanaka.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish-led set meals and izakaya plates, beef-tendon stew, dashi throughout (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_shunsai_tanaka_de_tanaka.hours_raw: Daily 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–23:00; irregular closing days posted on Instagram (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and advised — walk-ins turned away when full at lunch (Tabelog; July 2026). The owner may run lunch alone, so dishes come in order (April 2026). Rice refills appear to be free (April 2026). Cards; no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 17 seats incl. a counter in a renovated townhouse (Tabelog; August 2026). 3 min walk from Demachiyanagi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 13 March 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_shunsai_tanaka_de_tanaka.notes: [Japanese set meals and izakaya · by Demachiyanagi Stn] A renovated townhouse near Demachiyanagi that one reviewer likens to a kaiseki kitchen: lunch sets of thick-cut sashimi, tempura or fried fugu with five small obanzai for ¥1,200–2,000, and evenings of obanzai, saikyo-yaki and beef-tendon stew with sake. Popular with locals, so book; when the owner works lunch alone, expect a wait and brisk manners. Irregular closures on Instagram.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an izakaya opened 13 March 2023 near Demachiyanagi; registered as an official listing by the shop. A July 2025 reviewer calls it the lunch of a Japanese kaiseki restaurant; reviewers in 2026 note fish said to be shipped from Kochi (August 2026) and an owner handling a full room alone at lunch (April 2026).

anecdotes.text: An April 2026 lunch guest found the owner, handling everything alone, curt under the workload.
Another April 2026 diner was told dishes would come in order and chose the fried fugu and sashimi set — with firefly squid on the plate.
A March 2026 newcomer, drawn by the older regulars filing in, had a ¥1,200 fried-oyster set and noticed the cat-shaped chopstick rests.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋、左京区田中下柳町13-6、出町柳駅から徒歩3分、毎日 11:30〜14:00・17:00〜23:00、不定休 (Instagram で告知)、予約可、カード可、電子マネー・QR 不可、17席、カウンター、貸切可、2023年3月13日オープン。口コミ (2025年7月〜2026年8月、英語): 改装した町家、昼の定食1,200〜2,000円 (小鉢5品とご飯)、高知から届くという魚の厚切りのお造り、天ぷら、かんぱちの海鮮丼、牡蠣フライやふぐの唐揚げとお造り、天ぷらとお造りの旬菜定食2,000円、ご飯のおかわりは無料らしい、夜はお造りの盛り合わせ、おばんざい8品、揚げ出し豆腐、鰆の西京焼き、鱧のかき氷と梅肉、生湯葉の田楽、牛すじの煮込み、締めのそうめん、日本酒、店主一人の昼は待つ・愛想がないとの声、猫の箸置き、予約がおすすめ。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; Japanese set menus; cards.

existence.note: Official Tabelog listing; reviews through August 2026.

kyoto_grill_seiken_kaikan.gf_detail: Not GF: demi-glace hamburg, ebi fry in homemade breadcrumbs, crab cream croquette and beef curry (2026 reviews).
kyoto_grill_seiken_kaikan.vegan_detail: Not vegan: hamburg, pork sauté, fried shrimp, croquettes and beef curry (2026 reviews).
kyoto_grill_seiken_kaikan.hours_raw: Tabelog lists 12:00–14:00 (last order 13:30), closed Thursday, with lunch and dinner both until sold out; hours may change (Tabelog). Reservations accepted — weekday same-day bookings possible; lines at weekend lunch (Tabelog; May and August 2026). The menu can be limited on some days (July 2026). No cards or e-money; QR accepted (Tabelog). 27 seats: seven tables for two and two for four; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog; May 2026). 1F of the research-institute building on Shimogamo Morimoto-cho, by Shimogamo Shrine; Tadasu-no-Mori bus stop; paid parking to the south (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_grill_seiken_kaikan.notes: [Yoshoku · Shimogamo, by the shrine] A yoshoku restaurant of over sixty years in a research-institute building beside Shimogamo Shrine: a hearty special lunch of demi-glace hamburg, ebi fry in homemade crumbs and a crab cream croquette for ¥1,900, a spicy slow-cooked beef curry, and potage on the side. Lines at weekend lunch; the beef cutlet is paused while beef is dear. QR, no cards. Closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a yoshoku, hamburg and curry restaurant on the ground floor of a research-institute building in Shimogamo. Reviewers in 2026 describe a long-established restaurant of over 60 years (August 2026), lines at weekend lunch, a broad age range of guests, and a beef cutlet withdrawn because of rising beef prices (October 2026).

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 regular says many guests ask for the beef cutlet, the old speciality, which is off the menu while beef prices are high.
A May 2026 guest arriving just after noon on a weekend found six groups waiting.
An October 2026 visitor found the croquette and shrimp very good but the hamburg disappointing and the portion modest.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 洋食・ハンバーグ・カレー、左京区下鴨森本町15 生産開発科学研究所ビル1F、バス停 Tadasu-no-Mori、出町柳駅から726m、12:00〜14:00 (L.O.13:30)、木曜定休、昼も夜も売り切れまで、予約可、カード・電子マネー不可、QR 可、27席、禁煙、子ども可、南に有料駐車場 (1日600円)。口コミ (2026年5月〜10月、英語): 下鴨神社のそば、60年以上の老舗の洋食、週末の昼は行列、平日は当日予約も、お得なランチ1,500円 (140g のハンバーグと海老フライ2本)、スペシャルランチ1,900円 (ハンバーグ、自家製パン粉の海老フライ、蟹クリームコロッケ)、フルーティーなデミグラス、ポークソテー、辛口の牛肉のカレー、ポタージュ+400円、ポテトサラダ、ピクルスとらっきょう、名物だったビーフカツは牛肉の高騰で休止中、ハンバーグがいまひとつとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: Expect a queue at weekend lunch; book on weekdays; QR, no cards.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_amore_kiyamachi.gf_detail: Not GF: a trattoria-pizzeria of pizza, pasta and lasagna (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_amore_kiyamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: prosciutto, seafood carpaccio and ajillo, meat lasagna, carbonara and cheese pizzas (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_amore_kiyamachi.hours_raw: Thursday–Tuesday 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); closed Wednesday since 18 June 2025 (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, and advised for the terrace; same-day cancellations are charged the full meal price; groups of 10–20 by phone, three days ahead (Tabelog; September 2026). During the Kamogawa summer-deck season, a table charge of ¥350 per person for à la carte dinners (Tabelog original 鴨川納涼床期間中のディナータイム時アラカルトご注文の場合はテーブルチャージとしてお一人様350円(税込)頂戴致します。). 120 seats in four rooms, plus a riverside terrace and a summer noryo-doko deck; non-smoking (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Cards, e-money and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). Kiyamachi south of Bukkoji, on the Kamo River; 5 min walk from Kawaramachi or Gion-Shijo stations (Tabelog).
kyoto_amore_kiyamachi.notes: [Italian · Kiyamachi on the Kamo River, terrace and summer deck] A big, casual trattoria-pizzeria between Kiyamachi and the Kamo River: pizzas such as quattro formaggi or pork belly with Kujo negi, karasumi pasta, ajillo and carpaccio, enjoyed best on the riverside terrace or the summer noryo-doko deck. Book for the terrace. Some find portions small for the price, and one August 2026 table waited for water and food. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a trattoria-pizzeria, bar and pasta restaurant on Kiyamachi with a Kamogawa summer deck; registered as an official listing by the operator. Reviewers in 2026 describe terrace or indoor seating chosen at booking, a quick fill on holidays, and a regular who works nearby.
chef_bio.specialty: Pizza; terrace dining by the Kamo River.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 family wanted riverside dining but thought Japanese food too early for the children, and booked the Italian terrace instead.
An August 2026 friend from Kyoto booked the riverside terrace for a visitor who asked to drink by the Kamo River.
An August 2026 table was never brought water, though a group seated later was, and the food was slow.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリアン・バル・パスタ、下京区木屋町通仏光寺下ル和泉屋町161、阪急河原町駅・京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、木〜火 11:30〜15:00 (L.O.14:30)・17:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:30)、2025年6月18日から水曜定休、予約可 (当日キャンセルは料金全額、10〜20名は電話、大人数は3日前まで)、鴨川納涼床期間中のディナーのアラカルトはテーブルチャージ1人350円 (税込)、120席 (4つのエリア)、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可。口コミ (2025年6月〜2026年10月、英語): 鴨川沿い、テラス席と川床、プロシュートのマルゲリータ、クアトロフォルマッジ、豚バラと九条ねぎのピザ、細麺のボロネーゼ、からすみのパスタ、カルボナーラ、ラザニア、海老ときのこのアヒージョ、トマトサラダ、生ハム、まぐろと白身のカルパッチョ、デザートの盛り合わせ、ワイン、量が少なめとの声、水が出てこなかった・料理が遅いとの声 (2026年8月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Book the terrace; full charge for same-day cancellation; summer-deck table charge; cards, IC and QR.

existence.note: Official Tabelog listing; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_nihonshu_satoshi.gf_detail: Ask. Kaiseki-style courses with miso-cured and soy-seasoned dishes, sashimi, and charcoal-grilled seafood (official site; 2025–26 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_nihonshu_satoshi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a Japanese kitchen built on katsuo dashi, with charcoal-grilled Ise lobster, eel and fish (official site; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_nihonshu_satoshi.hours_raw: Lunch 12:00–14:00 (reservation only, last entry 13:00), dinner 17:30–23:00 (last entry 21:00); closed irregularly (official site; Tabelog). Reservations accepted; cancellations the day before or on the day cost ¥10,000 per person, or 100% of a kaiseki course, also for reduced numbers (official site). Service charge 5%, or 10% for arrivals after 20:00 (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「サービス料一律5％、20時以降の入店は10%頂戴いたします。」). Cards (VISA, Master); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). 11 seats: a 7-seat counter and a table for 4; private hire for 5 or more (official site). Non-smoking; children welcome — give ages when booking (Tabelog). In a renovated old house on Ogawa south of Aneyakoji; 5 min from Karasuma Oike and Nijojo-mae Stns (Tabelog; January 2025). Opened June 2020 (official site).
kyoto_nihonshu_satoshi.notes: [Japanese cuisine and sake · Nijo, a former Wakuden head chef’s counter] An 11-seat renovated townhouse where the owner, 17 years at Wakuden, cooks almost single-handed: a run of small sake snacks, sashimi, and seasonal fish, Ise lobster or eel over binchotan, from a ¥5,500 three-course omakase. Strong on sake, with frequent sake events; drinks are pricey and late arrivals pay 10% service. Strict cancellation fees.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed on the site’s pages read; "Tomofumi Hoshina" in a January 2025 review), formerly head chef of Murasakino Wakuden’s bento kitchen (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site (店主紹介): born 28 June 1975; worked at 鶴清 from 1997 and joined Wakuden in April 1999, rising through the grill, the cutting board and the simmering station at Kyoto Wakuden in Kyoto Isetan, then becoming head chef of the Murasakino Wakuden bento workshop in the owner’s thirties, with further kaiseki work at Kodaiji, Nagoya and Osaka Wakuden; left in September 2016 after 17 years and opened 日本料理と日本酒 惠史 in June 2020. Some furniture and tableware date from the Edo period.
chef_bio.philosophy: To work worthy of the Wakuden name, in gratitude to the okami and seniors there (official site).

anecdotes.text: An April 2025 first-timer was impressed by the variety of appetizers and how well the chef ran almost everything alone, with international staff and guests.
A January 2026 regular came for a Fukushima recovery dinner, for which the owner travelled to Fukushima to source the ingredients.
An April 2025 couple found some starters a bit salty and the five slices of seared kinmedai sashimi a little slight for the ¥5,500 course.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 古民家を改装した隠れ家、日本料理と日本酒 惠史 (さとし)、伊勢海老・鰻・京野菜などを専用の炉と備長炭で焼く炭焼料理、伊勢海老の殻の赤だし、店内の日本酒はすべて購入可、江戸時代からの家具や器、店主は老舗料亭 和久傳で料理長も務めた (1975年生まれ、1997年鶴清、1999〜2016年 和久傳、京都和久傳、紫野和久傳の弁当工房の料理長、高台寺・名古屋・大阪の和久傳)、2020年6月開業、12:00〜14:00 (予約のみ)・17:30〜23:00、不定休、11席 (カウンター7、テーブル4)、前日・当日キャンセルは一人一万円、懐石は100%。食べログ: サービス料一律5%、20時以降の入店は10%、カード (VISA・Master)。口コミ (2025年1月〜2026年3月、英語): おまかせ3品5,500円・6,000円、蕗味噌、味噌漬けの卵や豆腐、鯖のへしこ、焼き河豚、日本酒の飲み放題13,000円 (新政など15種)、福島の食材と酒の会、飲み物は高め。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead (cancellation fees apply); counter seats watch the cooking. International staff and guests (April 2025). No English evidence found.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through March 2026.

kyoto_hayaokitei_udon.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: wheat udon from the neighbouring noodle factory; tempura (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_hayaokitei_udon.vegan_detail: Not vegan: udon in dashi broth; egg, kamaboko and shrimp tempura toppings (2025–26 reviews). The vegetable tempura udon still comes in dashi (January 2026).
kyoto_hayaokitei_udon.hours_raw: 6:00–13:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Holiday hours vary and are posted on Tabelog (September 2026). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). CASH ONLY — no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog). Self-service: order at the counter, collect your bowl, pay at the counter (February 2026). 12 table seats in a simple space beside the noodle factory, partly enclosed with plastic sheeting, plus outdoor tables (Tabelog; January–February 2026). Non-smoking; children welcome; 2 parking spaces, tight (Tabelog; April 2026). Beside 谷口製麺所 in Shogoin; 5 min from the Higashiyama Nijo bus stop, 8 min from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_hayaokitei_udon.notes: [Udon · Shogoin, breakfast udon from 6 am] A plastic-curtained shed beside a Shogoin noodle factory serving udon from 6:00: kitsune, tempura or curry udon for ¥600–800, and cold tub udon — up to three servings for ¥1,000. Soft noodles in a gentle broth; order, collect and pay yourself. Popular with early travellers, cyclists and walkers. Cash only; closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an udon shop in a simple space beside 谷口製麺所 (Taniguchi noodle factory). A November 2025 review says the noodles and broth are made with water from a well 70 m beneath the factory.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 traveller off an overnight bus came at 6:30 and chose an outside table to wake up.
A December 2025 regular shared the room with a cycling tour, elderly couples out for a morning walk and office workers.
A November 2025 visitor found the thin, very soft noodles not to personal taste.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: うどん・日本料理・天ぷら、左京区聖護院蓮華蔵町9 谷口製麺所脇・簡易スペース、東山二条バス停から徒歩約5分、6:00〜13:00、水曜休み、予約可、現金のみ、テーブル12席、禁煙、子供可、駐車場2台、おかあちゃんうどん (卵とじ) 600円、きつね・天ぷら・しっぽくうどん各700円、カレーうどん800円。口コミ (2025年11月〜2026年9月、英語): 製麺所の地下70mの井戸水、鍋焼きうどん、野菜天ぷらうどん、桶うどん・冷たいつけうどん (3玉まで1,000円)、セルフサービス、柔らかい麺、早朝の旅行者に人気。

cultural_comfort.note: Order by saying the dish at the counter, collect it yourself, pay in cash. No English evidence found.

kyoto_baniku_umayaro.gf_detail: Ask. Horse sashimi with a sweet soy, yukhoe, yakiniku with sauces, sakura nabe, bibimbap (2026 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_baniku_umayaro.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a horse-meat specialist — sashimi, liver, yakiniku and hot pot (2026 reviews).
kyoto_baniku_umayaro.hours_raw: 16:30–1:00; Fri, Sat and days before holidays 16:30–3:00; open almost every day (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, best made early for Fri–Sat (Tabelog). Appetizer charge ¥400 (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「お通し代 400円」). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 56 seats, cramped (Tabelog; August 2026). Smoking allowed at all seats (Tabelog; August 2026). 1F of SAKIZOビル north of Shijo on Kiyamachi; 2 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 21 September 2012 (Tabelog). Busy nights can stretch the young staff (October 2026).
kyoto_baniku_umayaro.notes: [Horse meat · Kiyamachi Shijo, sashimi to yakiniku until late] A lively, smoky horse-meat specialist off Kiyamachi: mixed horse sashimi, sweet raw liver, yukhoe bowls, horse yakiniku and sakura nabe, with friendly young staff who explain the cuts. Open to 1:00, or 3:00 at weekends; smoking at every seat; ¥400 appetizer charge. Book for Friday and Saturday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a horse-meat specialist (yakiniku, shabu-shabu, horse dishes) opened 21 September 2012. Tabelog also lists 馬肉酒場 金山 馬野郎 in Nagoya. An August 2026 reviewer chose it as a regular entry in Tabelog’s top-100 lists that allows smoking at all seats.

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 group booked the Sakura yakiniku course, saw the sakura nabe next door, asked to switch, and were happily allowed to.
An August 2026 diner liked the assorted sashimi so much it was ordered twice, with different cuts the second time.
An October 2026 diner found the sashimi assortment underwhelming but the horse liver outstanding.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼肉・しゃぶしゃぶ・馬肉料理、中京区四条通木屋町二筋上ル西紙屋町368-1 SAKIZOビル 1F、京都河原町駅から徒歩2分、16:30〜翌1:00 (金土・祝前日は翌3:00まで)、ほぼ無休、予約可、お通し代400円、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、56席、全席喫煙可、2012年9月21日オープン、名古屋に 馬肉酒場 金山 馬野郎。口コミ (2026年6月〜10月、英語): 馬刺し5種盛り、生レバー、ユッケとユッケ丼、馬焼肉、さくら鍋、桜焼肉コース、ビビンバ、自家製バター、さつまいものデザート、ソフトドリンク飲み放題600円、若い店員が親切、席が狭い。

cultural_comfort.note: Staff explain the cuts and how to cook each one (September 2026); smoking at all seats; ¥400 appetizer charge. No English evidence found.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_chinese_enen.gf_detail: Not gluten-free as a menu: dim sum, spring rolls, sesame balls, kara-age, ramen (2026 reviews).
kyoto_chinese_enen.vegan_detail: Not vegan: pork, chicken, crab, egg and shrimp dishes (2026 reviews).
kyoto_chinese_enen.hours_raw: 11:00–14:30 and 17:00–22:00 (last order food 21:30, drinks 22:00); closed Thursday, at New Year and over the Chinese Spring Festival — call for details (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, and dinner fills up (Tabelog; September–October 2026). No service charge (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「なし」; Tabelog’s English wrongly says one may be added). No cards or e-money; PayPay accepted (Tabelog; October 2026). 42 seats at tables; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). On Imadegawa west of Teramachi, facing north, near Doshisha University and the Imperial Palace; 6 min from Demachiyanagi Stn (Tabelog; November 2026).
kyoto_chinese_enen.notes: [Chinese · Teramachi Imadegawa, a hotel chef’s home cooking] A calm neighbourhood Chinese restaurant by the Imperial Palace, cooking over 50 dishes from Shanghai to Sichuan with real spices: a ¥1,100 daily lunch set (mapo tofu, yellow chives and pork), a ¥1,980 dim sum set, and century egg, sweet and sour pork and spicy fried rice at night. Book dinner; cash or PayPay. Closed Thursday.

roles: Chef (unnamed), formerly head chef at a four-star hotel in China (September 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per a September 2026 review: the chef was formerly head chef at a four-star hotel in China and offers over 50 dishes of Shanghai, Guangdong, Beijing and Sichuan home cooking with authentic spices. Tabelog notes closures at New Year and over the Chinese Spring Festival.

anecdotes.text: A November 2026 visitor was served tea instead of water by a staff member in a cute outfit, and had the ¥1,100 daily mapo tofu set with a rice refill.
An October 2026 regular always orders the Taiwanese century egg and noticed new and off-menu dishes.
A September 2026 family was glad to have booked during the holiday week — it was full.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 中華料理・飲茶、上京区今出川通寺町西入ル大原口町211 1F、出町柳駅から徒歩6分、11:00〜14:30・17:00〜22:00、木曜休み、年末年始と春節は休み、予約可、サービス料なし、カード不可・PayPay 可、42席、禁煙、子供可。口コミ (2026年9月〜11月、英語): 中国の四つ星ホテルの料理長だった料理人、上海・広東・北京・四川の家庭料理50品以上、日替わりランチ1,100円 (ご飯おかわり可)、点心セット1,980円、ピータン、よだれ鶏、トマトと卵、かに玉、黒酢の酢豚、麻婆豆腐、韮黄と豚肉の炒め、薬膳鍋のラーメン、お茶が出る、夜は満席も。

cultural_comfort.note: Order the daily set at lunch or à la carte at night; cash or PayPay. No English evidence found.

kyoto_italian_rokare.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: fresh pasta, pizza, bread and fried dishes (2022–2026 reviews); no allergen information.
kyoto_italian_rokare.vegan_detail: Not vegan: an appetizer platter of prosciutto, quiche and fish; meat and fish mains (2022–2026 reviews).
kyoto_italian_rokare.hours_raw: Tabelog: 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30) and 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); closed irregularly. Lunch is served only some days — check the shop's Instagram first (March 2026). Book: 15 seats (3 at the counter, 12 at tables; one table for six). No service or cover charge — Tabelog, Japanese original 「サービス料・チャージともなし」. No cards or e-money (Tabelog). Non-smoking. On the Sanjo-kai shopping street (2024–2025 reviews). Opened 1 August 2016 (Tabelog).
kyoto_italian_rokare.notes: [Italian · Sanjo-kai arcade, a one-cook wine trattoria] A tiny trattoria on the Sanjo-kai shopping street where one cook turns out a ¥1,000 appetizer platter and a long list of Italian small plates, meats and pasta at gentle prices — regulars come back for birthdays. It is slow when full (April 2024); there was no wine list to price bottles from (September 2025). Book; lunch only some days. No cards.

roles: Owner-cook, not named in a source
chef_bio.background: Opened 1 August 2016 (Tabelog). Diners describe a small room "basically run by the owner alone" (April 2022), "a one-person operation" (April 2024) and "just one staff" (November 2024); in September 2025 two young men were working.

anecdotes.text: April 2024: "Since it's a one-person operation, it takes a while to serve when it gets crowded."
September 2025: there was a sign saying "Enjoy wine at night," but "there was no wine bottle menu available… I simply asked for a 'reasonable option'."
March 2026: "The pasta was fresh, but I personally prefer dried pasta" — and "I wish they had a wider selection of soft drinks."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリア料理 ロカレ、イタリアン、中京区御供町296、二条城前駅から徒歩10分、11:30〜14:00 (L.O. 13:30)・17:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:30)、不定休、15席 (カウンター3席、テーブル12席)、原文で「サービス料・チャージともなし」、カード・電子マネー不可、禁煙、2016年8月1日オープン。口コミ (2022年4月〜2026年3月、英語): 三条会商店街、ほぼ店主一人の店、前菜の盛り合わせ1,000円 (生ハム、キッシュ、白いんげんとツナ、鮮魚、ごぼうのピクルス)、花ズッキーニのフライ、鮎のコンフィ、丹波鶏のスパイス揚げ、アクアパッツァ、青森の黒毛和牛のタリアータ、トリッパのトマト煮、鴨のロースト、牛ほほ肉の煮込み、ピザ、ンドゥイヤのトマトソースのパスタ、からすみのパスタ、ワタリガニのトマトクリームのパスタ、昼はたまにで1,800円 (Instagram で確認)、混むと遅いという声、ワインのボトルのメニューがないという声、生パスタは好みでないという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Tiny local trattoria; book ahead; no cards.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated through March 2026.

kyoto_hiyoko_zushi.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: soy sauce with the sushi, ponzu, red miso soup and grilled fish (2023–2026 reviews); no allergen information.
kyoto_hiyoko_zushi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish sushi counter (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_hiyoko_zushi.hours_raw: Tabelog lists no opening hours, only irregular closing days; a May 2026 diner noted "they open early." Reservations taken (Tabelog). 13 counter seats; the entrance is inside the building, a little hard to find (October 2025). Table charge: about ¥400, varying by day — Tabelog, Japanese original 「約400円程（日によって異なります。）」; a July 2023 diner reckoned the otoshi at ¥500. English menu; the chefs speak English (August 2025). Children welcome; take-away. Cards (Visa, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), transit IC and nanaco; no QR. Non-smoking (smoking spot in the passage outside).
kyoto_hiyoko_zushi.notes: [Sushi · Shijo-Omiya, an everyday counter by the station] A 13-seat counter beside Hankyu Omiya Station for casual, reasonably priced sushi and sashimi with a drink — omakase nigiri around ¥2,000, an English menu and chefs who speak English to the tourists now staying nearby. One diner disliked the chef's attitude (January 2022); another found the pieces small and the chawanmushi poor value (December 2024). About ¥400 table charge.

roles: Sushi chefs, not named in a source
chef_bio.background: A regular on a 33rd visit (July 2023) says the shop moved into the present building, across from where it used to be, and is now cleaner and larger. Reviewers from 2024 to 2026 describe two chefs — one relatively young — and a young man serving drinks, many regulars, and more foreign tourists as hotels and holiday rentals have spread around Omiya.

anecdotes.text: January 2022: "The only downside is that I'm not a fan of the chef's attitude."
December 2024: "The sushi pieces were quite small… and the iconic seafood chawanmushi only had two small pieces of what seemed to be leftover fish, not properly set."
March 2025: at a counter of American, Russian and Indian families, a regular "recommended them the warm Kikumasamune sake."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ひよこ寿司、寿司・日本料理・居酒屋、中京区大宮通四条上ル錦大宮町130、阪急大宮駅から徒歩2分、営業時間の記載なし、不定休、予約可、カウンター13席、原文で「約400円程（日によって異なります。）」のチャージ、カード・交通系IC・nanaco可、QR不可、禁煙 (店の前の通路に喫煙所)、子供可、持ち帰り可。口コミ (2017年9月〜2026年8月、英語): 1貫150〜300円 (2017年)、おまかせ握り2,000円で10貫ほど、ちょい飲みコース3,000円 (2023年)、鉄火巻650円、海鮮茶碗蒸し700円、刺身の盛り合わせ、かま焼き、ほや、熱燗は菊正宗、予算を伝えると合わせてくれる、英語のメニューと英語で話す職人、移転して広くなった、大将の態度が苦手という声、ネタが小さく割高という声。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu; the chefs speak English (August 2025).

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_bansan_kyoshoku.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: homemade pizza, tempura and kakiage, nama-fu, soy-based sauces (official site; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_bansan_kyoshoku.vegan_detail: Not vegan: yakitori, offal, sashimi and dashi dishes; the grilled vegetables come with a tamami-miso sauce (official site; reviews).
kyoto_bansan_kyoshoku.hours_raw: Tabelog and official site: 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:30); closed Sunday — when Monday is a public holiday, open Sunday and closed Monday. Book: fully booked early evenings and walk-ins turned away (July 2026); 2.5-hour limit. One drink per guest — Tabelog, Japanese original 「当店全てのお客様にワンドリンク制をお願いしております。」 Ordering by smartphone (July 2025). 38 seats: counter on the ground floor, tatami and sunken-kotatsu seating upstairs for up to 20; the ground-floor private room allows smoking, so no children there. Courses with all-you-can-drink from ¥5,500 for 4 or more, booked by the day before (official site). Cards (Visa, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money.
kyoto_bansan_kyoshoku.notes: [Izakaya · Shijo-Karasuma, yakitori in an alley townhouse] A renovated townhouse at the end of a narrow alley off Yanaginobanba: big Kyoto-chicken skewers, grilled offal, Kyoto vegetables, yuba with ikura and a homemade pizza, with a long sake list — popular for dates and parties, so book. One diner found the yakitori salty and the corn tempura heavy (August 2026). One drink each. Closed Sunday.

roles: Not named in a source; run by 株式会社 京色 (official site)
chef_bio.background: One of five Kyoto restaurants run by 株式会社 京色, founded by a president and two chefs who studied together at a cooking school and trained in Japanese, Western and creative cooking (official site); its sisters are うらやま京色 (kushiage), 祇園 晩餐 京色, 祇園天ぷら晩餐 and 角打ちと麺 ばんさん (official site). Reviewers in 2026 describe a stone-paved approach, a counter downstairs and sunken seating upstairs, individually plated course dishes, and fish from the central market each morning.
chef_bio.philosophy: From the site: particular about ingredients such as Kyoto Akadori chicken and fresh vegetables, for "bold dishes with delicate technique hidden in them" (official site, translated).
chef_bio.specialty: Kyoto Akadori yakitori; grilled vegetable platter.

anecdotes.text: July 2026: "I made a reservation for an early time, but the place was already fully booked. They were turning away customers without reservations."
August 2026: "The yakitori was a bit salty… The tempura corn had a bit too much batter, resembling a fritter, but it was delicious."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: BANSAN 京色、焼鳥・居酒屋・海鮮、中京区柳馬場通四条上ル瀬戸屋町473-1、烏丸駅・四条駅から徒歩5分、17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 22:30)、日曜休み (翌日が祝日なら日曜営業・翌日休み)、利用は2.5時間、原文で「当店全てのお客様にワンドリンク制」、38席、個室 (1階は喫煙可で子供不可、2階の掘りごたつは最大20名)、カード・PayPay可、電子マネー不可。公式サイト: 京赤地鶏の大ぶりの焼き鳥、ホルモン炭焼、焼野菜、自家製ピザ、日本酒、宴会コース5,500円 (90分飲み放題、8品)、定番コース6,600円 (120分、9品)、接待・観光向け7,700円、4名から前日までに予約。株式会社 京色は、うらやま京色、BANSAN、祇園晩餐、天ぷら晩餐、角打ちと麺 ばんさんを運営、食の専門学校で共に学んだ社長と料理人2人が立ち上げた。口コミ (2025年7月〜2026年10月、英語): 細い路地の奥の町家、スマホで注文、刺身の盛り合わせ2,500円、汲み上げ湯葉のいくらのせ950円、蓮根のつくね500円、バーニャカウダ、鱧の天ぷら、つぶ貝のわさび和え、生麩田楽、だし巻、土鍋ご飯、早い時間でも満席で予約なしは断っていた、焼き鳥が塩辛くとうもろこしの天ぷらの衣が厚いという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; one drink per guest; smartphone ordering.

existence.note: Tabelog listing with reviews dated through October 2026; listed on the operator's site.

kyoto_junmai_sakekasu_tamanohikari.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: salt-koji karaage, fried horse mackerel and sea bream, soy- and miso-seasoned obanzai (2026 reviews). Allergy requests must be made by the day before a booking (Tabelog).
kyoto_junmai_sakekasu_tamanohikari.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish namerou, karaage, pork and fish set meals; kasujiru (2026 reviews).
kyoto_junmai_sakekasu_tamanohikari.hours_raw: Official site: tasting bar (1F) and restaurant (2F) 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:30); shop 11:30–15:00 and 17:30–21:30; closed irregularly and 31 December–3 January. Shaved ice in summer (July–September) 11:30–17:00. No service charge — Tabelog, Japanese original 「なし」 (the English page says one is added). Allergy needs and booking changes by the day before (Tabelog). 60 seats: 1F bar 16, 2F 34, an annex room for 10; private hire with minimum spends. Non-smoking. Cards, transit IC and e-money, many QR (PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay). Opened 1 March 2022 (Tabelog).
kyoto_junmai_sakekasu_tamanohikari.notes: [Sake-lees cooking · Shijo-Karasuma, Tamanohikari brewery's townhouse] Fushimi brewer Tamanohikari's own townhouse: a ground-floor bar where ¥1,500 buys 30 minutes of self-pour from about fifteen of its sakes, and an upstairs dining room of gentle sake-lees and koji lunches with amazake and kasujiru, and sake-paired courses at night. Some found portions small and service slow (September 2026). No service charge.

roles: Not named in a source; run directly by 玉乃光酒造 (official site)
chef_bio.background: Run directly by the sake brewer 玉乃光酒造 of Fushimi, which began brewing in 1673 in Wakayama and is now in its 13th generation (official site); opened 1 March 2022 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2026 describe a renovated townhouse with a bar on the ground floor, a dining room upstairs, staff in Tamanohikari T-shirts, and sake events such as a September 2026 sanma night.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per its site, a place to eat dishes made with the brewery's junmai sake lees with its sake, and a showcase of ideas for using them at home (official site, paraphrased).
chef_bio.specialty: Sake-lees and koji cooking; self-pour sake bar.

anecdotes.text: August 2026: for ¥1,500 "They handed me a wine glass, and I could fill it with any of the 15 varieties of Tamano Hikari sake in any amount I wanted."
September 2026: "the portion size would feel quite small… Additionally, the service takes some time."
August 2026: "the sea bream had a bit of a fishy taste… The pork set meal was a bit on the smaller side and felt rather bland."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京都・伏見の玉乃光酒造の直営のレストランとショップ、純米酒粕を使った料理と玉乃光の酒、延宝元年 (1673年) に和歌山で創業し現在は13代目、1階テイスティングバーと2階レストランは11:30〜15:00 (L.O. 14:30)・17:30〜22:00 (L.O. 21:30)、ショップは11:30〜15:00・17:30〜21:30、不定休、12月31日〜1月3日休み、夏のかき氷。食べログ: 純米酒粕 玉乃光、日本料理・居酒屋・おでん、下京区因幡堂町658-1、四条駅5番出口から徒歩3分、1階バーは30分飲み放題1,500円、原文でサービス料「なし」、アレルギーは前日までに、60席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR可、2022年3月1日オープン。口コミ (2026年8〜11月、英語): 約15種の玉乃光の自分で注ぐ飲み放題、酒粕の鯛のなめろう、酒粕カレー、京の発酵おばんざいランチ、塩麹の唐揚げ、なめろうとアジフライ、豚ロースの定食、甘酒、粕汁、500円の日本酒セット、5,000〜5,200円の飲み放題付きコース、ソフトクリーム、天然氷のかき氷、量が少なく提供が遅いという声、鯛が生臭く豚の定食が物足りないという声。

cultural_comfort.note: Self-pour sake bar downstairs; allergy requests by the day before.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_tamburino_imadegawa.gf_detail: Not GF: a spaghetti and pizza counter, with focaccia and bruschetta in the sets (2023–2025 reviews).
kyoto_tamburino_imadegawa.vegan_detail: Ask. An aglio e olio and tomato pastas appear, but most pastas use bacon, sausage, fish or cream; no vegan information (2023–2025 reviews).
kyoto_tamburino_imadegawa.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday and Friday 11:00–15:00 and 17:30–22:30; Wednesday, Saturday and Sunday 11:00–15:00 and 17:30–22:00; closed Thursday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). No cards; e-money and QR accepted (Tabelog). 16 seats: 8 at the counter and two tables of 4; smoking allowed, except at weekend and holiday lunch (Tabelog). On Imadegawa-dori east of the Kawabata crossing, by a bus stop; 5 min walk from Demachiyanagi Stn (Tabelog; January and August 2024).
kyoto_tamburino_imadegawa.notes: [Spaghetti · Imadegawa by Demachiyanagi, couple-run] A homely sixteen-seat spaghetti counter by a bus stop on Imadegawa, run by a friendly couple to a Beatles soundtrack, with album covers regulars have brought in: about ten pastas from ¥750, such as mentaiko or takana and tuna, cheap lunch sets, and Margherita or octopus pizza. Student-friendly prices. Smoking allowed except at weekend lunch. Closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a pasta and café counter near Demachiyanagi. Reviewers describe a couple running it (August 2024), a Beatles-loving owner with music and memorabilia on display, some brought in by regulars (August 2024; November 2025), and student-friendly prices near the university (February 2025).
chef_bio.philosophy: "Feel free to stop by even if you're alone" (May 2023 review).

anecdotes.text: An August 2024 diner, tempted in by the bus stop out front, chatted with the couple over a chilled tomato soup pasta, under Beatles records some say regulars brought in.
A November 2025 guest spotted a sign about yellow tomatoes that recalled the ones from Ryukoku.
A December 2025 reviewer loved the tomato sauce but thought the pizza dough an overlooked weak point.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: パスタ・カフェ、左京区田中下柳町8-12、京阪出町柳駅から徒歩5分、月・火・金 11:00〜15:00・17:30〜22:30、水・土・日 11:00〜15:00・17:30〜22:00、木曜定休、予約可、カード不可、電子マネー・QR 可、16席 (カウンター8、4人がけテーブル2)、喫煙可 (土日祝の昼は禁煙)。口コミ (2023年5月〜2025年12月、英語): 「一人でも気軽に」、今出川通沿い、川端の東、バス停の前、夫婦で営む、ビートルズの音楽とレコードジャケット、パスタは約10種で750円から、セットは800円から (ミニサラダやフォカッチャ)、カルボナーラ・ブルスケッタ・ミニサラダ・お茶のスペシャルランチ、明太子スパゲティ、ウインナーのアラビアータ、高菜とツナ、ほうれん草のボロネーゼ、アーリオ・オーリオ、鮭とアボカドの冷製トマトスープパスタ、ベーコンとアスパラのカルボナーラ風 (目玉焼き)、マルゲリータ、たこのピザ、カレー風味のミニバターライス、学生向けの値段、生地がもう一歩との声。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter and two tables; e-money and QR, no cards; smoking allowed except weekend lunch.

existence.note: Official Tabelog listing; latest review December 2025.

kyoto_demachi_karabinka.gf_detail: Ask. Spice curries on rice with fried onion and crisp toppings; the roux and toppings are not described for gluten (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_demachi_karabinka.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the signature black curry uses beef tendon; specials use chicken or anchovy; egg and cheese toppings (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_demachi_karabinka.hours_raw: Sunday–Friday and holidays 11:30–15:00; closed Saturday and occasionally on other days, posted monthly on Instagram; rarely an evening 17:00–21:00 (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog); a short wait outside at lunch (March 2026). No cards or e-money; QR accepted (Tabelog). 6–8 counter seats; non-smoking (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). At the corner of Teramachi just west of Kawaramachi-Imadegawa; 2–3 min from the Kawaramachi-Imadegawa bus stop, 10 min walk from Demachiyanagi Stn (Tabelog; May 2026).
kyoto_demachi_karabinka.notes: [Spice curry · Kawaramachi-Imadegawa, six seats] A tiny counter at the corner of Teramachi where the young owner cooks each plate alone: a mild, deeply sesame-rich black curry of beef tendon for ¥1,000, and a "kimagure" curry of the day that changes twice a month — ginger chicken, plum, anchovy chicken. Add a spice egg. Expect a short wait. QR, no cards. Lunch only; closed Saturday.

roles: Owner (unnamed, described as young), who cooks alone (June and September 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a curry counter at Teramachi-Imadegawa, with closing days posted on Instagram and occasional evening service. Reviewers in 2026 describe an owner who prepares each plate with care alone (March and June 2026); an August 2025 reviewer mentions a Saturday evening pop-up run by another curry cook.

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 walker on the Kamo River path from Sanjo was drawn in by the smell of spices.
A June 2026 three-time regular compares the limited ginger chicken curry with another shop's ginger dish.
An August 2025 dinner guest met a woman running a Saturday pop-up here and called that cook an artist of curry.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カレー、上京区真如堂前町98-3 アクアビル 1F、出町柳駅から徒歩10分、市バス・京都バス河原町今出川から徒歩2〜3分、日〜金・祝 11:30〜15:00、土曜定休 (ほかの休みは毎月 Instagram で告知、まれに17:00〜21:00の夜営業)、予約不可、カード・電子マネー不可、QR 可、8席 (カウンター)、禁煙。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年9月、英語): 寺町の角、カウンター6席、店主一人で営む、黒カレー (黒ごまと牛すじ) 1,000円、マイルドでクリーミー、カリカリのトッピング、福神漬け、はちみつ、月2回替わる気まぐれカレー (アンチョビのチキン1,100円、生姜のチキン、梅)、スパイスエッグ、半熟卵、焼きチーズ、揚げ蓮根、玉ねぎのピクルス、土曜の夜に別の作り手のポップアップがあったとの声 (2025年8月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Six counter seats, wait outside if full; QR, no cards; check Instagram for closures.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through September 2026.

kyoto_gonbee_gion.gf_detail: Not GF: wheat udon and soba with a sweet dipping sauce, tempura; oyakodon in a dashi-soy broth (2026 reviews).
kyoto_gonbee_gion.vegan_detail: Not vegan: dashi-based broths, oyakodon, egg dishes and tempura (2026 reviews).
kyoto_gonbee_gion.hours_raw: Monday–Wednesday and Friday 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–20:00; Saturday, Sunday and holidays 11:30–20:00; closed Thursday; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog; October 2026). Tatami seating, shoes off, plus some tables; non-smoking (Tabelog; October 2026). A historic townhouse with a right-to-left signboard on Gion-machi Kitagawa; 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; October 2026).
kyoto_gonbee_gion.notes: [Udon and oyakodon · Gion, a 1927 townhouse] A historic Gion noodle house up on tatami, once named in a magazine as serving Japan's best oyakodon: soft, creamy egg in a deep, unsweetened dashi with sansho, a ginger-laced keiran udon and kitsune udon, plus soba. Reviewers say kabuki actors and geisha have long come here. Prices feel high for the portions to some. Cash only; closed Thursday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an udon, soba and oyakodon restaurant in Gion. An October 2026 reviewer writes that it was founded in 1927 and is frequented by kabuki actors and geisha; a September 2026 reviewer recalls a food magazine long ago naming its oyakodon the best in Japan, and finds the restaurant unchanged.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 lunch party of three paid ¥9,600 in cash — and the payer, with only ¥10,000 on hand, called it a close call.
A September 2026 parent, arriving from Niigata, made a Gonbee oyakodon the first meal back in a city of student days.
An October 2026 traveller was sent here by a staff member at a well-known yatsuhashi shop.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: うどん・そば・親子丼、東山区祇園町北側254、京阪祇園四条駅から徒歩5分、月〜水・金 11:30〜15:00・17:00〜20:00、土日祝 11:30〜20:00、木曜定休、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、座敷とテーブル、禁煙、日本酒。口コミ (2026年8月〜10月、英語): 祇園の老舗、1927年創業 (2026年10月の口コミ)、右から読む看板、町家、靴を脱いで座敷へ、歌舞伎役者や芸妓が通う店との声、昔の料理雑誌で日本一の親子丼と紹介された、親子丼1,900円 (ふわとろの卵、甘くないだし、山椒)、生姜のあんの「けいらん」、きつねうどん、玉子丼、とろろそば2,100円、天ざるそば、そば湯がなかった、現金のみ、祇園らしく高め・量が少なめとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: Shoes off, tatami; no reservations; cash only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews through October 2026.

kyoto_daniels_nishiki.gf_detail: Not GF: fresh pasta, focaccia, quiche and pizza (2026 reviews).
kyoto_daniels_nishiki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: cream and meat pastas, pâté, conger eel, panna cotta (2026 reviews).
kyoto_daniels_nishiki.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday 11:30–15:00 (last order 14:30) and 17:30–22:00 (last order 21:30); closed Monday, or Tuesday when Monday is a holiday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and advised — a line forms before opening (Tabelog; October 2026). Sparkling water is served (October 2026). 46 seats, banquets up to 30 seated or 50 standing, and a private room on the 3F for 8–20 (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR incl. Alipay (Tabelog). 2F of the Glamorous Food building on Nishikikoji at Takakura, above Momoya, just east of Daimaru; from Karasuma or Shijo stations via exit 18 (Tabelog).
kyoto_daniels_nishiki.notes: [Italian · Nishikikoji behind Daimaru, fresh pasta] The bright, picture-hung main shop of Kyoto's Daniel's, up a floor on Nishikikoji: generous lunch sets of an appetiser platter, chewy fresh pasta, hot focaccia, dessert and coffee from about ¥2,000 (a ¥1,200 business lunch too), sparkling water on the table, and wine-friendly dinners. Lines before opening — book. Some find it ordinary for the price. Closed Monday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an Italian with an authentic Italian atmosphere and a 3F private room; registered as an official listing by the operator. Reviewers in October 2026 note several sister restaurants, call this the main branch, and describe sparkling water served at every Daniel's.
chef_bio.philosophy: An authentic Italian atmosphere (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: Two university classmates, from Kanto, reunited here in October 2026 for the first time in five years, after a conference.
A September 2026 group of three, turned away once when full, booked ahead and had the pasta split into three plates.
A September 2026 diner found the ¥2,900 Bon Appetit lunch good but no better than ordinary, and the room cramped.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: イタリアン・パスタ・ピザ、中京区錦小路通高倉西入ル西魚屋町596 グラマラスフードビル 2F (1階は Momoya)、大丸京都店の錦小路口から東へ、地下鉄四条駅・阪急烏丸駅18番出口から、火〜日 11:30〜15:00 (L.O.14:30)・17:30〜22:00 (L.O.21:30)、月曜定休 (祝日なら翌火曜)、予約可、46席、宴会 着席30名・立食50名、3階に個室 (8〜20名)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、本格的なイタリアの雰囲気。口コミ (2026年9月〜11月、英語): 本店、姉妹店がいくつか、開店前から行列、炭酸水のサービス、ビジネスランチ1,200円 (サラダ、生パスタ、フォカッチャ)、おすすめのパスタランチ2,070円 (前菜の盛り合わせ、パスタ、フォカッチャ、パンナコッタ、コーヒー)、ボナペティランチ2,900円、スペシャルは+600円、Shinshu の豚のトマトクリーム、かぼちゃのクリーム、きのこのトマト、栗とベーコン、鱧と枝豆の大葉のペスト、夜は季節の魚と肉、ワイン、誕生日のランチプラン、普通・狭いとの声。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead (lines at opening); set lunches; cards, IC and QR.

existence.note: Official Tabelog listing; reviews through November 2026.
