kyoto_kissa_poco_ekimae.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: toast and sandwich breakfasts; omurice and dry curry are not described for wheat (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kissa_poco_ekimae.vegan_detail: Not vegan: egg, ham and butter breakfasts, omurice (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kissa_poco_ekimae.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 6:00–19:30; breakfast 6:00–11:00. No reservations. Smoking allowed — ashtrays on every table (Tabelog; February 2026). Cash only: no cards, e-money or QR (Tabelog; July 2025). 14 seats: 6 at the counter, 8 at tables. Across from the Kyoto Station bus rotary, 2 min walk (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_kissa_poco_ekimae.notes: [Kissaten · Kyoto Station, 6 a.m. breakfasts with smoking] A narrow, Showa-era coffee shop across from the Kyoto Station bus rotary that opens at six: toast-and-egg breakfast sets from ¥600, a grandmotherly omurice and dry curry for lunch, plain coffee. Smoking is allowed throughout — a non-smoker found it hard going (March 2026). Cash only.

chef_bio.background: Reviewers from 2024 to 2026 describe a long, narrow room kept as it was in the Showa era, a master, an older couple who "seemed to be running the place" (February 2026), local regulars, and a smell of tobacco and coffee.

anecdotes.text: March 2026: "I entered without knowing it was a smoking establishment… the environment was not ideal for me since I don't smoke. However, the service from the lady… was excellent."
"I hope places like this continue to exist forever." — June 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ポコ、喫茶店・オムライス、下京区東洞院通塩小路上る東塩小路町550、JR京都駅から徒歩2分、毎日 6:00〜19:30 (モーニング 6:00〜11:00)、予約不可、14席 (カウンター6、テーブル8)、喫煙可、カード・電子マネー・QR不可。口コミ (2024年4月〜2026年10月、英語): 京都駅前のロータリーの向かい、昭和の喫茶店、全席に灰皿、モーニングは4種 (トーストとゆで卵650円、Bセット600円、Cセット700円、サンドイッチセット750円)、甘くない薄焼き卵のオムライス、ドライカレー750円、アイスコーヒー500円、ミックスジュース、コーヒーゼリー、現金のみ、年配の夫婦が切り盛りしているようだという声、たばこが苦手な人にはつらいという声。

roles: Owner, running the shop alone (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site, owner 川嶋隆徳 runs the seven-seat counter alone, pairing Kyoto sake with Kyo-duck raised in Kyotamba, and stocks sake from all 40 breweries in Kyoto Prefecture, large and small. chef_bio.philosophy: From the official site: Kyoto sake for visitors and locals alike — "京都の日本酒にこだわり" (particular about Kyoto sake).

May 2025: "Since the owner operates the restaurant solo, I want to be a considerate customer who can read the room… and not linger unnecessarily."
August 2026: "The portions are small, but they are unique delicacies that pair perfectly with drinks."

kyoto_kamehachi_honten.vegan_detail: Not vegan: beef-offal hot pot in dashi; horse sashimi, smoked mackerel (official site).
kyoto_kamehachi_honten.hours_raw: Official site and Tabelog: 17:00–24:00 (last orders food 23:00, drinks 23:30); open all year except irregular days (New Year, staff training). Two-hour limit when busy. Book through the official site (24 hours; the phone is often busy); weekends fill up, and winter is hard to book (official site). kyoto_kamehachi_honten.notes: [Motsu-nabe · Pontocho alley, Kyoto white-miso hot pot] The original shop (2008) of a three-shop Kyoto motsu-nabe house, tucked in an alley between Kiyamachi and Pontocho: Omi beef offal in a Kyoto dashi broth — the white-miso version is the one to order — finished with stone-ground noodles or egg zosui, and all-you-can-drink courses from ¥5,000. Book on the website; winter fills. ¥380 table charge.

roles: Second-generation manager known in the shop as "Pe-san" (official site); owner not named
chef_bio.background: Per the official site, 亀八 本店 opened in April 2008 as the first shop; the name pairs 亀 (turtle, for luck) and 八 (eight, for endless happiness). Early on the first manager stood outside every day calling in customers; word of mouth made it so busy that winter tables could not be booked, without spending on advertising. The second-generation manager, a regular of a sister shop since university who joined in 2009 and worked at the annex 亀八別館 first, keeps the founding recipe (official site). Sister shops: 亀八別館 (Pontocho) and 亀八 山科店 (official site).
chef_bio.philosophy: From the site: a hot pot that starts from taking dashi, the heart of Kyoto cooking — "a hot pot made for drinking the soup" (official site, translated).

anecdotes.text: August 2026: at the counter, "the manager and staff shared delicious ways to enjoy the food," and the white broth used a Kyoto ginjo white miso.

Service charge: none — Tabelog's Japanese original says 「サービス料：なし，チャージ料：なし」. Cards, IC cards and au PAY (Tabelog). Children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). The air conditioning runs cold — bring a layer (August 2026 review). On the east side of Kawaramachi just north of Shijo; 2 min from Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_eirakuya_honten.notes: [Sweets café · Kawaramachi-Shijo] The 2F café of a Kyoto confectioner right on Kawaramachi: lemon-and-cream-cheese or hojicha-kinako kakigori in summer, matcha parfaits with gyokuro ice cream, warabi mochi made to order; shop for sweets downstairs. About ¥1,000–2,000; no service or cover charge.

roles: Confectioners of 永楽屋 (no person named)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: the 本店 on Kawaramachi-Shijo, with a 室町店, a factory shop and counters in Daimaru and Takashimaya Kyoto; the 本店 sells sweets and tsukudani and has the café.
chef_bio.philosophy: Seasonal sweets from carefully chosen ingredients (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 regular came back for the Lemon Shizuku kakigori, which had sold out by evening on another visit.
A September 2026 visitor found a single chofu filling and the matcha on the light side.
An October 2026 diner felt the hojicha parfait could use a little less red bean paste.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 永楽屋、河原町四条の本店、室町店、山科の工場直売の本社売店、大丸京都店・高島屋京都店。食べログ (店舗会員): 永楽屋 本店、カフェ・和菓子、中京区河原町通四条上る東側、京都河原町駅から徒歩2分、1階物販 10:00〜19:00、2階カフェ 11:00〜19:00 (L.O. 18:30)、不定期の水曜休み、予約不可、サービス料なし・チャージ料なし、カード・電子マネー・au PAY 可、子供・ベビーカー可、レモンしずく氷、楽抹茶パフェ (玉露アイス、宇治抹茶ゼリー)、注文後に作るわらび餅。口コミ (2026年6〜10月、英語): レモンしずく氷1,600円、ほうじ茶きなこ氷、宇治金時、白玉、永楽パフェ、ほうじ茶パフェ、調布と抹茶、当日限りのどら焼き (三笠)、冷房が強い。

cultural_comfort.note: Café upstairs; menus with photos.

kyoto_grill_terrace_aburu.gf_detail: Ask. Pasta, curry, fried chicken and cakes (2025–26 reviews); Tabelog says allergy information is available.
kyoto_grill_terrace_aburu.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options; most lunch plates are meat or seafood (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_grill_terrace_aburu.hours_raw: Café weekdays 10:00–17:00 (last order 16:30), weekends and holidays 10:00–19:00 (last order 18:30); BBQ 10:00–21:30, last start 19:00; closed when the building is closed (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; BBQ bookings cancelled the day before or on the day are charged (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 108 seats: 60 on the terrace (unused in rain), 38 tables inside, 10 at the counter; parties up to 48 seated (Tabelog). Non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). Miyako Messe underground car park, no validation (Tabelog). 1st floor of Miyako Messe (Kyoto City Industry Hall), Okazaki; 8 min from Higashiyama Stn (Tabelog). Opened 3 July 2021 (Tabelog).
kyoto_grill_terrace_aburu.notes: [Café and BBQ · Okazaki, a terrace in Miyako Messe] The café on the ground floor of Miyako Messe, between the Heian Shrine and the Okazaki museums and zoo: plain-value lunches around ¥1,100–1,500 (Bolognese, fried chicken, curry), coffee and cake, and terrace BBQ booked ahead into the evening. Wheelchair-friendly, roomy and rarely crowded. Hours follow the building.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a café, dining bar and BBQ terrace on the first floor of Miyako Messe (Kyoto City Industry Hall), opened 3 July 2021. A June 2026 visitor found it much changed after a renovation.

anecdotes.text: A September 2025 wheelchair user recommended it as a good-value lunch near Okazaki Park, where many places are pricey, crowded or hard to reach.
A March 2026 visitor often lunches here when going to the zoo, finding it reasonable for the area.
An August 2026 visitor found the ¥600 90-minute drinks deal with soup a better buy than the famous coffee shop across the street.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: カフェ・ダイニングバー・BBQ、左京区岡崎成勝寺町9-1 みやこめっせ京都市勧業館 1F、東山駅から徒歩約8分、平日10:00〜17:00 (L.O. 16:30)、土日祝10:00〜19:00 (L.O. 18:30)、BBQ 10:00〜21:30 (最終入店19:00)、施設の休館日に準じる、予約可 (BBQ は前日・当日のキャンセル料あり)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、108席 (テラス60、店内38、カウンター10)、禁煙、車椅子可、ベジタリアンメニュー・アレルギー表示あり、2021年7月3日オープン。口コミ (2025年5月〜2026年8月、英語): 昼は約1,100円、ドリンク付きで約1,500円、唐揚げ1,100円、ボロネーゼ1,400円、シーフードカレー、ローストビーフ丼、600円で90分のドリンクとスープ、ケーキ、京まふとのコラボ、改装。

cultural_comfort.note: Order at the counter or table; spacious and wheelchair-accessible; book BBQ ahead. No English evidence found.

kyoto_meat_couture.gf_detail: Ask. Meat bistro dishes with house bread and short pasta (2025–26 reviews); Tabelog says allergy information is available.
kyoto_meat_couture.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a meat bistro — charcuterie, duck, lamb, wagyu, pork — with burrata (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_meat_couture.hours_raw: Mon, Wed–Sun 17:00–23:00 (last order food 22:00, drinks 22:30); closed Tuesday and irregularly (Tabelog). Reservations accepted and advised (Tabelog; November 2025). No children aged 7 or under; no strong perfume or fabric-softener scents — entry may be refused even with a booking (Tabelog). Cards and PayPay, no e-money (Tabelog). 16 seats, all at two large shared tables (Tabelog; August 2025). Non-smoking (Tabelog). On Akezu-dori by Higashi Honganji; 5 min from Gojo Stn, 7 min from Kyoto Stn (Tabelog; December 2025). Opened 17 October 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_meat_couture.notes: [Meat bistro · Higashi Honganji, shared tables and natural wine] A dim, stylish bistro near Kyoto Station with two big shared tables and the smell of baking bread: a charcuterie platter, burrata with seasonal fruit, duck, lamb and wagyu, with natural wines poured with the bottle and its tag beside you. No children 7 and under and no strong perfume. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a bistro specialising in meat, opened 17 October 2024, with all seating at shared tables and rules against young children and strong fragrance.
chef_bio.specialty: Meat appetizer platter; burrata with seasonal fruit.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 solo guest walked in without a booking on a rainy weekday and found the shared tables comfortable.
A November 2025 couple had the ¥12,000 anniversary course and liked having each glass’s bottle and tag left on the table.
A June 2026 regular wants to come every month for the appetizers, seasonal fruit and burrata.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ビストロ・肉料理、下京区不明門通上数珠屋町亀町8、五条駅から徒歩5分、京都駅から徒歩7分、月・水〜日17:00〜23:00 (L.O. 料理22:00、ドリンク22:30)、火曜休み (不定休あり)、予約可、7歳以下不可、香水や柔軟剤など強い香りは不可、カード・PayPay 可、16席 (すべて相席)、禁煙、2024年10月17日オープン。口コミ (2025年8月〜2026年9月、英語): 肉の前菜盛り合わせ (ローストビーフ、生ハム、パテ)、季節の果物とブラータ、鴨、ラム、和牛、ショートパスタ、豚のソテー、焼きたてのパン、記念日コース2名12,000円、自然派ワイン、クラフトビール、日本酒。

cultural_comfort.note: Book ahead; seats are shared; no children 7 and under and no strong perfume. No English evidence found.

kyoto_goris_kitchen.gf_detail: Not gluten-free as a menu: wood-fired pizza, pasta and homemade focaccia (2026 reviews).
kyoto_goris_kitchen.vegan_detail: Not vegan: mozzarella pizzas, anchovy carbonara, shrimp pasta, prosciutto (2026 reviews). No vegan information.
kyoto_goris_kitchen.hours_raw: Lunch from 11:30 to 14:00 on Monday, 13:45 Tue–Fri, 14:15 at weekends and holidays; dinner 17:30–22:00; may close when ingredients run out; closed irregularly (Tabelog; the official site says open all year with occasional closures). Reservations accepted; dinner fills up (Tabelog; October 2026). Cards at dinner only — lunch is cash or PayPay (Tabelog). 34 seats: 6 at the counter, 16 at tables, a 12-seat tatami room, and a semi-private back room for parties; high chairs for small children (Tabelog). Non-smoking; parking available (Tabelog). Among warehouses and offices 7 min from Kintetsu Jujo Stn, west of Omiya-dori (Tabelog; October 2026). Opened 5 May 2016 (Tabelog).
kyoto_goris_kitchen.notes: [Pizza and Italian · Kamitoba near Jujo, a wood-fired local favourite] A busy Italian among warehouses south of Kyoto Station, worth the walk for wood-fired pizza with a chewy crust — the signature Gori’s margherita, honey pizza, half-and-half for ¥300 more — anchovy carbonara and homemade focaccia. Lunch sets with salad and soup; dinner is often full, so book. Cards at dinner only.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a pizza, Italian and izakaya restaurant opened 5 May 2016. An August 2026 reviewer remembered the food from an earlier food truck.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 diner had loved the food from the shop’s food truck and found everything at the restaurant just as good.
A September 2026 diner who walked 20 minutes at 9 pm was told much was sold out but was glad to order what was left.
An October 2026 lunch guest found that drinks and sides are extra even at lunch, so a pizza alone is just the pizza.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ピザ・イタリアン・居酒屋、南区上鳥羽菅田町65、近鉄十条駅から徒歩約7分、昼 月11:30〜14:00・火〜金11:30〜13:45・土日祝11:30〜14:15、夜17:30〜22:00、食材がなくなり次第終了、不定休、予約可、カードは夜のみ (昼は現金か PayPay)、34席 (カウンター6、テーブル16、座敷12)、奥に半個室、禁煙、駐車場あり、2016年5月5日オープン。公式サイト: 年中無休 (臨時休業あり)。口コミ (2026年8月〜10月、英語): 薪窯のピザ (ゴリーズピザ、はちみつ、日替わり、ハーフ&ハーフ300円増し)、アンチョビのカルボナーラ、桜海老や海老と枝豆のオイルパスタ、サラダとスープ付きの昼のセット、自家製フォカッチャ、以前のキッチンカー、夜は満席も。

cultural_comfort.note: Book dinner; pay by cash or PayPay at lunch; family-friendly with high chairs. No English evidence found.

kyoto_anji_karasuma_rokkaku.gf_detail: Ask. Seafood izakaya with sashimi, soy-simmered fish, ebi mayo and fried oysters (2026 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_anji_karasuma_rokkaku.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a seafood izakaya — sashimi, simmered fish heads, grilled shellfish (2026 reviews).
kyoto_anji_karasuma_rokkaku.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:00 (last order 13:30), dinner 17:00–1:00 (last order 0:00), every day except 31 December–3 January and 11 February (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; no outside food or drink (Tabelog). Late-night charge ¥418 per person after 22:00 (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「22時以降は深夜料金418円（税込）が発生いたします」). Cards incl. UnionPay; PayPay, Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 75 seats; the front counter is quieter than the back (September 2026). Non-smoking with a smoking room (Tabelog). 2nd floor of 星の子六角ビル east of Karasuma on Rokkaku; 3 min from Karasuma Oike Stn exit 5 (Tabelog).
kyoto_anji_karasuma_rokkaku.notes: [Seafood izakaya · Karasuma Rokkaku, fish till 1 am] A big second-floor seafood tavern by Rokkakudo, fish sent direct from the ports: thick-cut sashimi, simmered sea-bream head, grilled shellfish and seasonal oysters with sake, from about ¥3,000 a head. Good-value seafood lunches (bowl ¥1,300) every day. Open to 1:00 with a ¥418 charge after 22:00. Sit at the front counter for quiet.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a seafood izakaya ("fishing-port direct") open all year except New Year and 11 February. Tabelog lists two other Anji in Kyoto (麩屋町綾小路店, 府庁前店).

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 regular of many years calls it the best fish izakaya in Kyoto and ordered oysters and matsutake that night.
A July 2026 visitor praised the simmered sea-bream head for its balance of soy, sake, mirin and ginger.
An October 2026 lunch guest found the fried oysters small and mostly batter, though the sides and salad were good.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・海鮮・日本料理、中京区六角通烏丸東入ル堂之前町231 星の子六角ビル 2F、烏丸御池駅5番出口から徒歩3分、昼11:30〜14:00 (L.O. 13:30)、夜17:00〜翌1:00 (L.O. 0:00)、12月31日〜1月3日と2月11日以外は無休、予約可、持ち込み不可、22時以降は深夜料金418円、カード・PayPay・Alipay・WeChat Pay 可、75席、禁煙 (喫煙室あり)、京都に麩屋町綾小路店と府庁前店も。口コミ (2026年4月〜10月、英語): 鯛のあら炊き、兜蒸し、厚切りの刺身盛り、貝やいかの焼き物、みりん干し、牡蠣、松茸、一人3,000円から、昼の海鮮丼1,300円、刺身定食、海老マヨやユッケ丼、カキフライ、手前のカウンターは静か。

cultural_comfort.note: Big menu of seafood; counter seats are quieter; ¥418 charge after 22:00. No English evidence found.

kyoto_jijibaba_daisan_sakaba.gf_detail: Ask. A Chinese-leaning izakaya — mapo tofu, gyoza, spring rolls, fried rice, mapo noodles, sweet-and-sour pork; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_jijibaba_daisan_sakaba.vegan_detail: Not vegan: mapo dishes, chashu, gyoza and pork dishes; a glass-noodle salad and mushroom stir-fries appear, but sauces are not described (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_jijibaba_daisan_sakaba.hours_raw: Monday–Thursday and Saturday 18:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); Friday 18:00–23:30 (L.O. 23:00); closed Sundays, holidays and the first and third Mondays (Tabelog). Reservations by phone only — AI and third-party bookings are not accepted; book or check for seats, as it fills (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). Otoshi ¥440 (Tabelog, original お通し440円). Cash only (Tabelog). 15 seats (Tabelog). Down an alley about 7–10 min from Kyoto Station (Tabelog; June 2025).
kyoto_jijibaba_daisan_sakaba.notes: [Chinese izakaya · alley near Kyoto Station, the master’s mapo tofu] A cramped, cheerful 15-seat izakaya in an alley near Kyoto Station, full of regulars and a talkative master who cooks very good Chinese-style food: mapo tofu and mapo noodles, gyoza, a special potato salad with chashu, spring rolls and fried rice. Phone to book; cash only; ¥440 otoshi. Part of the local じじばば group.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s invoice number T3130001048832 is registered to 株式会社じじばば (NTA register), which also runs 酒肴屋 じじばば and じじばば木馬亭. Reviewers describe “the chatty owner” (September 2026), “the quirky owner and regulars” (February 2026) and a master whose warm personality is “almost frustrating to praise” (October 2026).
chef_bio.specialty: Mapo tofu; chashu and potato salad.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 regular, back after a few years, was glad the master remembered.
A January 2025 visitor drops in for one more drink before the last train when a table is free.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: じじばば第三酒場、居酒屋・バル・中華料理、下京区新シ町138、京都駅から徒歩7分、月〜木・土 18:00〜23:00 (L.O.22:30)、金 18:00〜23:30、日・祝と第1・第3月曜休み、予約は電話のみ (AIや外部サービス経由は不可)、お通し440円、現金のみ、15席、適格請求書 T3130001048832 (株式会社じじばば)。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 中華の居酒屋、おしゃべりなマスター、麻婆豆腐、麻婆麺、麻婆丼、餃子、特製ポテサラ、チャーシュー、春巻き、炒飯、酢豚、春雨サラダのお通し、常連が多く満席になりやすい。

cultural_comfort.note: A regulars’ bar; phone bookings only; cash only; ¥440 otoshi.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through October 2026.

kyoto_izumo_kanoka.gf_detail: Ask. Lunch with nine obanzai and a choice of main — rice-flour udon, chicken yuzu-pepper bowl, Wagyu — plus cheesecake; afternoon tea of sweets, quiche and savouries; the udon is made with rice flour (official site), but nothing else is described (2026 reviews).
kyoto_izumo_kanoka.vegan_detail: Ask. Nine obanzai with each lunch and a pickle rice bowl, but dashi and dairy in the sweets are not described (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_izumo_kanoka.hours_raw: 11:00–18:00; closed Thursday; on weekdays reservation only, and the café stays closed if no one has booked (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; private hire by phone (Tabelog). Service charge 10% (Tabelog, original サービス10％). Cash only (Tabelog). 28 table seats; private rooms upstairs for up to 15 (Tabelog). Room and whole-house rental, and a photographer from ¥50,000, booked by LINE (official site). In a residential lane on Higashinakasuji north of Kitakoji, 12 min from Kyoto Station; staff will meet guests who get lost (Tabelog; May 2026).
kyoto_izumo_kanoka.notes: [Machiya café · near Kyoto Station, afternoon tea in a trunk] A deep-red 1896 townhouse tucked in a residential lane, serving a nine-obanzai lunch with rice-flour udon, Wagyu or rice bowls (¥3,500) and seasonal afternoon teas presented in a trunk box. Weekdays by reservation only; 10% service charge; cash only. The house can also be rented, with a photographer.

chef_bio.background: The official site describes a 130-year-old machiya dating from 1896 (Meiji 29) and offers rooms for rent. A May 2026 visitor who got lost was met by a staff member; reviewers found the staff kind (June 2026).

anecdotes.text: A June 2026 guest booked for 16:30 on a Saturday and had the rose afternoon tea as the only guest, in a room that felt set for a proposal.
A May 2026 visitor got lost on the way, phoned, and was met nearby by the staff.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京町家いづも 花のか、百年の歴史ある京町家、130年の町家 since 1896 (明治29年)、9種のおばんざいランチ (鶏ゆず胡椒丼、米粉うどん、特選和牛)、トランクのアフタヌーンティー、レンタル・貸切あり (個室3,300円/2時間ほか)、カメラマン50,000円から、予約はLINE。食べログ: カフェ・スイーツ、下京区東中筋通北小路上がる紅葉町364、京都駅から徒歩12分、11:00〜18:00、木曜定休、平日は予約制で予約がなければ休み、サービス10%、現金のみ、28席、2階の個室は15名まで。口コミ (2026年、英語): 3,500円のランチ、薔薇のアフタヌーンティー4,000円、ひまわりの夏のトランクのアフタヌーンティー9,000円、秋のアフタヌーンティー、写真撮影付きのアフタヌーンティー、チーズケーキ、場所がわかりにくい。

cultural_comfort.note: Weekdays by reservation only; hard to find — staff will guide you; cash only; 10% service charge.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog; reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_lantan_shogoin.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: homemade wheat noodles in a soy-sauce broth (2026 reviews).
kyoto_lantan_shogoin.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the broth is meat-based (one reviewer calls it tonkotsu shoyu); even the “meatless” ramen is served in the same broth (2026 reviews).
kyoto_lantan_shogoin.hours_raw: 11:00–14:00; closed Wednesday and the second and fourth Tuesdays (Tabelog; hours may change). No reservations (Tabelog). Cash only (Tabelog). 23 seats: 8 at the counter and tables (Tabelog). Non-smoking (Tabelog). Near the entrance of Kyoto University Hospital in Shogoin, about 600 m from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; March 2026). Founded in 1964 (May 2026 review).
kyoto_lantan_shogoin.notes: [Ramen · Shogoin by Kyoto University Hospital, since 1964] A lantern-lit, Showa-era ramen shop serving a light, slightly sweet soy ramen with homemade thin noodles — regular, chashu or a cheaper meatless bowl — to regulars and hospital visitors. Lunch only, 11:00–14:00; cash only.

chef_bio.background: A May 2026 reviewer dates the shop to 1964 and mentions a famous actor among the regulars; another May 2026 visitor counts 62 years in business. A September 2026 regular finds it “not delicious, but not bad either”, a taste from before ramen became a luxury.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 visitor chose the ¥720 meatless ramen because a second ramen stop was planned later that day.
A May 2026 family’s children loved the gentle broth.

kyoto_brulee_kyoto_sanjo.notes: [Doughnuts · Sanjo shopping arcade] A tiny doughnut stand in the long Sanjo arcade that does one thing: a soft doughnut stuffed with custard, sugared and torched in front of you so the top cracks like crème brûlée (about ¥400). Eat it on the spot or carry it home carefully. Cash only.

anecdotes.text: A May 2026 passer-by asked if the doughnut could be eaten right away; the staff torched it on the spot.
A December 2025 buyer warns that the matcha coating comes off on the way home.

kyoto_kamo_hiro.gf_detail: Ask. Duck hot pot in a soy-based broth, beef tongue stew, hayashi rice and tempura; no gluten information is published (official site; reviews).
kyoto_kamo_hiro.vegan_detail: Not vegan: duck hot pot and meat stews (official site).
kyoto_kamo_hiro.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–13:30 and dinner 17:00–22:00 (last order food 20:30); closed Thursday and at lunch on Sundays and holidays; may close for catering jobs — phone ahead (official site; Tabelog). No service charge listed on Tabelog; the shop’s site has quoted the duck hot pot as tax and service included. 18 seats: a 6-seat counter facing the Kamo River and tatami seating; private hire; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog; official site). On Reizen-dori just west of Kawabata in Okazaki-Shogoin, 515 m from Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; April 2025). Opened 1988 as a kappo (official site).
kyoto_kamo_hiro.notes: [Kappo · Shogoin by the Kamo, duck hot pot since 1988] A long-running neighbourhood kappo with a six-seat counter looking out over the Kamo River toward Mt. Hiei. Its fame is duck hot pot, with thick cuts of duck (course about ¥6,000); lunch is homely yoshoku — hayashi rice and a tender beef tongue stew for about ¥1,200. The owner likes a chat across the counter. Closed Thursday and Sunday lunch.

roles: Owner-chef (店主) not named; born and raised in Kyoto (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: opened in 1988 as a kappo in Okazaki-Shogoin; the owner, born and raised in Kyoto, calls the cooking 京人料理 — Kyoto cooking shaped by its people — and serves tongue stew, hayashi rice and duck hot pot as easy introductions to kappo; seasonal omakase menus are posted each season (latest November 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: kappo is about conversation across the counter — "won’t you stretch a little and talk with us?"

anecdotes.text: An April 2025 diner had duck hot pot by the river with the cherry blossoms in full bloom.
A February 2026 first-timer for duck hot pot was disappointed by the service.
A May 2025 regular came back for the hayashi rice with its rich demi-glace and crunchy onions.

kyoto_ogihiroya_sanjo.gf_detail: Ask: Tabelog lists gluten-free options, and reviewers mention rice-flour kara-age fried in rice oil and brown-rice udon. A gluten-intolerant diner found the take-home pickles contain wheat (grain vinegar), so ask about each pickle (Tabelog; March and July 2026 reviews).
kyoto_ogihiroya_sanjo.vegan_detail: Ask. Pickles and rice are plant-based, but the soups, kara-age, dashimaki and side dishes are not; nothing vegan is marked (2026 reviews).
kyoto_ogihiroya_sanjo.hours_raw: Monday–Wednesday, Friday and the days around holidays 10:00–16:00 (last order 15:30) and dinner 17:00–21:00 (last order 20:30, reservation only); Saturday, Sunday and holidays breakfast 7:30–10:00; closed Thursday (Tabelog). Lunch-only pickle buffet; weekend-only pickle breakfast; set meals at all hours from July 2026; hot-pot banquets for up to 16 with 3 days’ notice (official site). Prices revised from 7 January 2026 (official site). No service charge or other fees (Tabelog). 9 seats; cards, transit IC, iD, QUICPay and PayPay (Tabelog). On Sanjo-dori just east of Horikawa, about 6 min from Nijojo-mae Stn (Tabelog). Opened 26 November 2023 (Tabelog).
kyoto_ogihiroya_sanjo.notes: [Japanese · Sanjo-Horikawa, an all-you-can-eat pickle lunch] A rustic little dining room of a Kyoto pickle maker near Nijo Castle. At lunch, help yourself to a buffet of additive-free Kyoto-vegetable pickles — shibazuke, red turnip, burdock, seasonal picks — with fresh rice and soup (¥1,800); weekend mornings bring a ¥1,000 pickle-and-congee breakfast. Rice-flour kara-age appeals to gluten-avoiders, but check the pickles. Closed Thursday.

roles: Operator 株式会社アシスト (invoice holder); staff not named
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: traditional flavours handed down since the business was founded, Kyoto-vegetable pickles served in a rustic setting, and rice supervised by the eighth-generation Gihei with a 16-grain mix. Opened 26 November 2023 (Tabelog). The invoice number belongs to 株式会社アシスト, registered in Takatsuki, Osaka.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: Kyoto vegetables chosen to bring out the umami of each, in pickles made to a recipe handed down since the founding.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 diner with gluten intolerance found the pickles on the buffet tasty but discovered wheat in the take-home pickles’ ingredients, and suggests brown-rice udon, kara-age or dashimaki for wheat-allergic guests.
A July 2026 visitor loved the rice-flour kara-age fried in rice oil.
A March 2026 couple had the weekend pickle breakfast with seasonal pickles such as zucchini and bamboo shoot.

cultural_comfort.note: Buffet at lunch; dinner by reservation only.

kyoto_rokusou.gf_detail: Ask. Seasonal Italian courses with pasta and bread; no gluten information is published (official site).
kyoto_rokusou.vegan_detail: Ask. A vegetarian course is offered with three days’ notice (lunch 7 dishes ¥8,250, dinner 9 dishes ¥14,850); ask whether it can be made vegan (official site).
kyoto_rokusou.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–14:00 (last order food 12:30); dinner 18:00–21:30 (last order food 19:30); closed Wednesday and the 2nd Tuesday (Tabelog). Bookings via TableCheck or phone (official site). Courses change monthly; vegetarian course with 3 days’ notice (official site). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 8 seats at a single-board counter, plus a sunken table, in a renovated townhouse where shoes come off; non-smoking; cards and QR (Tabelog; October 2025). Near the north-east corner of the Imperial Palace, about 10 min from Demachiyanagi Stn (601 m) (official site; Tabelog). The invoice is registered to 永谷六方.
kyoto_rokusou.notes: [Italian · north-east of the Imperial Palace, a Hanase chef's mountain Italian] An eight-seat counter in a renovated townhouse near Demachiyanagi, where chef 永谷六方 — raised among the mountains of Hanase — turns seasonal produce into quiet, aromatic Italian with Japanese touches; the course changes monthly. Lunch from ¥6,600, dinner from ¥12,650; vegetarian courses with three days' notice. Shoes off at the door. Closed Wednesday.

chef_bio.background: Per the official site: born 30 June 1980 and raised in Hanase among the mountains, whose seasons and nature remain the foundation of the cooking and the décor; trained at La Barcarola in Niigata, Ristorante Acqua Pazza in Tokyo and Chourakukan Coral in Kyoto; now blends Hanase sensibility with Italian technique to express each season on the plate. The invoice is registered in the owner’s name.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: each plate expresses the season, from the food to the tableware and quiet time at the counter.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 regular on a fourth visit describes the chef as modest and quiet, with the cooking reflecting that personality.
An October 2025 lunch guest took off shoes at the entrance and sat by the window at the counter.
An August 2026 visitor paired the lunch course with wine.

kyoto_oryori_yamagami.gf_detail: Ask. Kappo dishes, tempura and juwari (100% buckwheat) soba with dipping sauce; no gluten information is published (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_oryori_yamagami.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fish-led kappo with dashi (reviews).
kyoto_oryori_yamagami.hours_raw: Lunch 11:00–14:00 (soba; only on days a sign is out — irregular); dinner 17:00–23:00; closed Thursday, and 29–31 December; no lunch 29 December–3 January, reservations required 1–3 January (Tabelog; January 2024). Cash only — no cards or e-money (Tabelog). No service charge listed (Tabelog). 18 seats: a 10-seat counter and a private room for 6–8; private hire; smoking allowed per Tabelog. In a narrow lane near Keihan Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (162 m), near Kyoto University Hospital (Tabelog; November 2025).
kyoto_oryori_yamagami.notes: [Kappo · Jingu-Marutamachi, late-night kappo with hand-made soba] A hidden kappo down a lane by Jingu-Marutamachi Station, loved by professors and fellow chefs, serving classic seasonal dishes until 23:00 and ending with the owner's fine juwari soba. Dinner is made to your budget (about ¥5,000–10,000); on days a sign is out, lunch is a soba set with a tekka-don (about ¥1,400). Cash only; smoking allowed. Closed Thursday.

roles: Owner-chef not named; works with a hostess (October 2024)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog’s official introduction: a hidden shop on a narrow street near Jingu-Marutamachi Station, loved by university professors and other restaurant owners, serving authentic Japanese cuisine until late; lunch was started at regulars’ request, with 100% buckwheat soba made by the owner, who even travels to Shinshu for soba tools.
chef_bio.specialty: Juwari soba to close a kappo dinner.

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 regular booked lunch ahead to ask for matsutake and eel.
A November 2025 visitor after a hospital appointment came for the lunch-only soba and found it excellent with salt alone.
A December 2025 guest was introduced by a Kyoto University professor.

kyoto_future_train_umekoji.gf_detail: Ask. Themed courses and plates with crepes, chiffon cake and fried dishes; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_future_train_umekoji.vegan_detail: Ask. Courses feature chicken and local meats with sweets; no vegan information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_future_train_umekoji.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 11:00–16:00 (last order 15:00) and 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); Saturday, Sunday and holidays 11:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); hours change over New Year and holidays (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). Entrance fee on a first visit: adults ¥700, children up to sixth grade ¥300, under-3s free; a 5% service charge at dinner only (Tabelog original 入場料（初回来店時のみ） 大人 700円／お子様 300円（小学6年生まで／3歳まで無料）、ディナーのみサービス料5％). Some reservations and a Railway Museum ticket waive the entrance fee (August 2026). Fully cashless — no cash accepted; cards, e-money and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 80 seats over three train cars; children welcome (Tabelog; August 2026). On the Umekoji High Line in Umekoji Park, opposite the Kyoto Railway Museum; 1 min walk from Umekoji-Kyotonishi Stn (Tabelog; October 2026).
kyoto_future_train_umekoji.notes: [Themed dining · Umekoji High Line, a train car opposite the Railway Museum] A real Thunderbird express car, painted pink and set on an old elevated track, turned into a kawaii entertainment restaurant: light-and-sound shows, chick mascots, character parades and multi-course meals that reviewers find better than expected. Great with children after the Railway Museum. First-visit entrance fee ¥700; 5% service at dinner; cashless only. Open daily.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: billed as Japan's first elevated restaurant and café, on the Umekoji High Line; registered as an official listing by the operator. Reviewers in 2026 describe a front car from the former Thunderbird express between Kyoto and Hokuriku, with replica cars and a platform behind (November 2026), and a concept produced by Sebastian Masuda, likened to Harajuku's Kawaii Monster Cafe (August 2026); an October 2026 reviewer says it opened the year before.
chef_bio.philosophy: A future-train entertainment restaurant of food and art (August 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 parent came after the Railway Museum and found the museum ticket waived the entrance fee; Car 3 is the roomiest for children.
A July 2026 guest expected style over substance at the 15-course weekend dinner and was surprised by the cooking.
An October 2026 birthday trip ended here, a year after the restaurant opened.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ダイニングバー・カフェ・洋食、下京区観喜寺町3-7 梅小路ハイライン、JR梅小路京都西駅から徒歩1分、JR京都駅から徒歩15分、月〜金 11:00〜16:00 (L.O.15:00)・17:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:00)、土日祝 11:00〜22:00 (L.O.21:00)、年末年始と祝日は変更あり、予約可、入場料 (初回のみ) 大人700円・子ども300円 (小学6年生まで、3歳まで無料)、ディナーのみサービス料5%、完全キャッシュレス、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、80席、日本初の高架上のレストラン&カフェ。口コミ (2026年7月〜11月、英語): 梅小路公園、京都鉄道博物館の前、ピンクに塗った元「サンダーバード」の先頭車両、2両目からはレプリカ、音と光の演出、ひよこのキャラクター、週末のディナー「NIGHTPARADE DINNERPARTY」15品、6,000円のコース、滋賀のツアーディナー、鉄道博物館のチケットで入場無料、3号車が広い、Sebastian Masuda のプロデュース、家族連れや誕生日に。

kyoto_fukuyoshi_nishijin.notes: [Sushi · Nishijin townhouse, Nakadachiuri] A seven-seat counter and private tatami rooms in a beautifully kept Nishijin townhouse, where the chef works alone over sushi made with kamado-cooked rice: hairy crab, nodoguro, kohada, salt-grilled anago, uni, and onigiri of the fresh rice. Calm and quiet — one 2026 guest wanted more chat. Reservation only; 20% service in tatami rooms. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Owner-chef (unnamed), who prepares the dishes alone (April 2023 review)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a reservation-only sushi and Japanese restaurant in Nishijin with a counter and private tatami rooms; registered as an official listing by the shop. anecdotes.text: An August 2023 guest headlined the visit "A sushi restaurant in a National Important Cultural Property".
A March 2024 lunch guest, given a private counter at the back, did not realise from the townhouse front that it was a restaurant.
An October 2026 diner, invited through a dining credit card, found the room beautiful but missed the chatty style of other sushi counters.

kyoto_ekimae_sakaba_jurakudai.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sashimi, duck, wagyu and a sake-lees hot pot; Kyoto dashi throughout (2026 reviews).
kyoto_ekimae_sakaba_jurakudai.hours_raw: Monday–Friday and the day before holidays 16:00–23:30; Saturday, Sunday and holidays 14:00–23:30; last order 23:00 (Tabelog). Reservations accepted (Tabelog). kyoto_ekimae_sakaba_jurakudai.notes: [Sake izakaya · by Higashi Honganji, near Kyoto Station] A roomy, newly opened izakaya from the Sasaki Shuzo brewery, three minutes from Kyoto Station: house sakes such as Jurakudai, flights and an all-you-can-drink sake course, with Kyoto-flavoured plates — sashimi, Kamo eggplant dengaku, Miyama yuba, wagyu cutlet and a sake-lees hot pot. A sake cup comes as the ¥420 otoshi. Service can be uneven when busy. Evenings, from 14:00 at weekends.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a Kyoto-style Japanese izakaya serving Sasaki Sake Brewery's sake; registered as an official listing by the operator. October 2026 reviewers call it a newly opened izakaya produced by the historic Sasaki Shuzo, the family business of actor Kuranosuke Sasaki.
chef_bio.philosophy: Sasaki Sake Brewery's sake with Kyoto-style dishes (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 sake fan, with only an hour, came to drink Sasaki Shuzo sake — the family business of actor Kuranosuke Sasaki — and found a hand-shaped dish with painted nails on the menu tableware.
An October 2026 pair reserved tatami for two after seeing photos, but were seated at a small table on a crowded night.
A September 2026 guest liked the sake otoshi but found the dishes arrived unevenly.

kyoto_gihan_gyoza_sakaimachi.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 11:30–14:30 (last order 14:00) and 17:30–22:00 (food last order 21:00, drinks 21:30); Saturday and holidays 11:30–15:00 and 17:30–22:00; closed Sunday; bar service from 22:30 on Thursday–Saturday (Tabelog). kyoto_gihan_gyoza_sakaimachi.notes: [Gyoza and Chinese · Sakaimachi near Karasuma Oike] A busy, good-value Chinese bar overseen by the creative-Chinese 一之船入: several gyoza (shrimp and green onion, ginger, cilantro), saliva chicken, mapo tofu and lu rou fan, ¥1,200 lunch sets with almond tofu, and courses with Shaoxing wine on the free-flow list. Queues at opening; time limits when busy. Closed Sunday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a gyoza and dumpling restaurant serving authentic Chinese food; registered as an official listing by the operator. Reviewers in 2026 describe it as part of the group with the Sanjo shop and 創作中華 一之船入, which supervises it (August–October 2026), popular with solo women at lunch and with overseas visitors at night.
chef_bio.philosophy: Authentic Chinese food (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 six-time regular came after a film at Uplink Kyoto and noted the lunch had risen from ¥1,100 to ¥1,200 — still a good deal.
A September 2026 guest found the ¥2,500 lunch course huge and tasty, but warned against expecting the level of the famous parent.
An October 2026 diner found the Pu-erh tea tasted and smelled strange.

kyoto_totoya_central_market.notes: [Seafood · by the Central Wholesale Market, Umekoji] A fish shop at the market gate with a busy set-meal room behind: thick sashimi sets with a rich red miso soup, a ¥1,000 two-tuna bowl, crisp fried conger eel. In the evening the front turns into a standing bar where you choose your fish and drinks. Closes with the market. A few find it ordinary. Closed Wednesday, Sunday and holidays.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a sushi, eel and standing-bar listing beside the Kyoto Central Wholesale Market, with retail sales, lunch and izakaya hours; registered as an official listing by the shop. Reviewers in 2026 describe a fish market with a dining area at the back, daily dishes that change with the market's catch, and an evening standing bar.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 guest came for fried conger eel, worried it would be gone, and was told to ask for more tartare sauce.
An August 2026 family stopped in after playing in Umekoji Park, and found it good but not distinctive.
An October 2026 diner praised the savvy service of the woman at the counter.

kyoto_germer_jodoji.hours_raw: Wednesday, Thursday, Saturday and Sunday 12:00–22:00; Friday 13:00–22:00; closed Monday and Tuesday; bread sales 12:00–21:00 until sold out, restaurant from 18:00; hours may change (Tabelog). kyoto_germer_jodoji.notes: [Bakery and bistro · near Ginkakuji, couple-run] A tiny bakery off Shirakawa-dori whose croissant some call the best in Kyoto — moist, buttery, crisp — with pain de mie, campagne and Danish that sell out fast; prices are not always posted, and some find prices high. By night, the chef and wife serve an eight-seat, reservation-only course of rare ingredients, from Maison Mito foie gras to Miyama game. Closed Monday and Tuesday.

roles: Chef and baker, Mr. Okamoto (as named by reviewers)
The wife of the chef, who runs the shop together (May 2024; August 2026)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a bread, bistro and wine-bar shop near Ginkakuji with bread sales from midday and a restaurant from 18:00. Reviewers describe the couple who run it, chef Okamoto, called a bread artist after a TV feature (February 2025), and a dinner course built on carefully sourced ingredients such as foie gras from Maison Mito, nerve-killed fish and game from Miyama (August 2026).
chef_bio.philosophy: Carefully sourced, rare ingredients (August 2026 review).

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 eleven-time regular advises buying bread a few times and asking about the ingredients before booking the dinner course, to build trust with the couple.
A February 2025 visitor, drawn by a TV feature, watched the croissants sell out through the window and settled happily for a bacon épi and a crab-cream Danish.
A November 2025 shopper found no prices posted and paid ¥780 for one loaf.

kyoto_thisis_shizen_shinpukan.vegan_detail: Ask. The flowers are shaped from bean paste, but sit on dairy ice cream (vanilla or matcha); no vegan information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_thisis_shizen_shinpukan.hours_raw: Daily 10:00–19:00; hours may change (Tabelog). No reservations; queues at weekends (Tabelog; 2026 reviews). Cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). kyoto_thisis_shizen_shinpukan.notes: [Sweets · Shinpuhkan, Karasuma Oike] A museum-like café of plants and art where bean paste is piped into roses, hydrangeas or a puppy over ice cream, finished leaf by leaf before your eyes — a photo first, a dessert second. Flavours run from coffee to beet and ramune. Around ¥1,350–1,950; queues on weekends and many visitors from abroad. Some find the taste ordinary or very sweet. Open daily.

roles: Café staff (unnamed), who finish each bouquet at the counter
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a café in Shinpuhkan with a website at thisis.website/shizen. Reviewers in 2026 describe an interior of plants, art and tableware like a museum or botanical garden, seasonal flower designs, and staff who finish the leaves of each order in front of the guest.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 visitor who expected ice cream found the rose was made of bean paste — and the ramune flavour a revelation.
A September 2026 guest photographed the staff adding the front paws to a caramel dog bouquet.
A September 2026 visitor found the taste average but the presentation worth nearly ¥2,000.

kyoto_yagura_honten_shijo.notes: [Soba and udon · Shijo opposite the Minamiza] A long-established noodle shop a minute from Gion-Shijo Station, playing old festive koto music: famous nishin soba with sweet-simmered herring, silky yuba ankake soba, Kyoto-style tanuki udon in a thick sauce with Kujo negi, curry udon and a rich oyakodon. Usually easy to get in even amid the crowds. Cash only; prices plus tax.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a soba, udon and curry shop on Shijo near Gion with a website at yagura-net.com; registered as an official listing by the shop. Reviewers in 2026 call it a long-established soba shop famous for nishin soba, across from the Kyoto Minamiza.

anecdotes.text: A March 2026 diner learned that in Kyoto "tanuki" means chopped fried tofu in a thick sauce, not tempura bits.
A March 2026 first-timer had yuba ankake soba to traditional New Year-style music, the room nearly full at 17:30.
An October 2026 guest got a table quickly at lunch despite the station-side location.

kyoto_mazemen_maruta.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but the signature mazemen use dashi and chashu (2026 reviews).

Reservations accepted and advised at weekend lunch (Tabelog; October 2026). Cards, e-money and QR incl. Alipay and WeChat Pay (Tabelog). 17 seats: 6 at the counter and tables (Tabelog). Non-smoking; wheelchair accessible; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). 10 min east of Marutamachi Stn, 4 min west of Jingu-Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 8 December 2016 (Tabelog).
kyoto_mazemen_maruta.notes: [Mazemen · Kawaramachi Marutamachi, Kyoto flavours on noodles] A clean, stylish counter near the Kamo River making soupless mazemen with Kyoto twists — white miso and yuzu dashi, sudachi soy dashi with an onsen egg — plus inventive seasonal bowls such as fig with sakura-smoked chashu. Prices are a little high, so many guests are overseas visitors. Book for weekend lunch. No ramen block: the sources do not cover all six dimensions.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an abura-soba, mazesoba and ramen shop opened 8 December 2016, with vegetarian options. Ramen block not given: the sources do not cover all six ramen dimensions.
chef_bio.specialty: White-miso yuzu dashi mazemen; seasonal mazemen.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 regular came back on purpose for the mizunasu mazemen, missed on its last day the year before.
A September 2026 visitor arrived 15 minutes after opening to be first for the fig and sakura-smoked chashu mazemen.
A July 2026 diner noted the higher prices and the many overseas guests.

kyoto_harebare_shichijo.gf_detail: Ask. Izakaya dishes with oden, gyoza, fried corn, soba and soy-seasoned fish (2023–26 reviews); no gluten information.
kyoto_harebare_shichijo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: sashimi, roast beef, bacon, oden in dashi (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_harebare_shichijo.hours_raw: Sun, Mon, Wed, Thu and holidays 17:30–23:00; Fri, Sat and days before holidays 17:30–24:00; closed Tuesday and the 3rd Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations by form; 2-hour seating; overseas guests are asked to give a mobile number that works in Japan or the name of the hotel (Tabelog). Online bookings are paid in cash only; otherwise cards, no e-money or QR (Tabelog; January 2026). Service charge 20% from 26 December to 5 January (Tabelog, Japanese text: 「12/26~1/5迄はサービス料20%を頂戴致します。」). 13 seats: 7 at the counter and one tatami room for 6 (Tabelog). Dogs welcome in a bag or cart (Tabelog; 2023–25 reviews). Non-smoking; smoking in the courtyard, or inside if hired privately (Tabelog). In a 100-year-old house at the Kawaramachi Shichijo bus stop; 5 min from Shichijo Stn, 10 min from Kyoto Stn (Tabelog; November 2024). Opened 30 June 2022 (Tabelog).
kyoto_harebare_shichijo.notes: [Izakaya · Kawaramachi Shichijo, dogs welcome in a century-old house] A 13-seat izakaya in a 100-year-old townhouse by the Kawaramachi Shichijo bus stop where dogs can join you at the counter: Kyoto vegetables, sashimi, oden with red konnyaku and homely plates like a pork-and-cabbage omelette. Regulars fill half the counter, and one August 2026 newcomer found the service slow and cool. Closed Tuesday.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an izakaya with seafood and creative dishes, opened 30 June 2022, in a renovated house that a November 2024 review puts at about 100 years old.

anecdotes.text: An October 2023 guest came for the dog-friendly counter and swapped dog stories with overseas visitors over appetizers, without a common language.
A March 2025 couple tried buri sashimi with senmaizuke for the first time and were served one shared soba on two plates.
An August 2026 visitor felt regulars came first and found the staff unfriendly to newcomers and the dishes slow.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 居酒屋・海鮮・創作料理、下京区河原町通七条上る住吉町354、七条駅から徒歩5分、京都駅から10分、日月水木祝17:30〜23:00、金土・祝前日17:30〜24:00、火曜と第3水曜休み、フォームで予約、2時間制、外国の客は日本で使える携帯番号かホテル名を、ネット予約は現金のみ、12/26〜1/5はサービス料20%、13席 (カウンター7、座敷6)、ペットはバッグかカートで、禁煙 (中庭に喫煙所)、2022年6月30日オープン。口コミ (2023年10月〜2026年8月、英語): 築100年の家、京野菜と鮮魚、霜降りのローストビーフ、京のアスパラの塩焼き、ベーコンのサラダ、豚とキャベツの卵焼き、一口餃子、とうもろこしの揚げ物、ヤングコーンや筍のおでん、赤こんにゃく、鰤の刺身と千枚漬け、鱧の湯引き、犬と一緒に入れる、常連が多い。

kyoto_pasta_more_kyoto_station.vegan_detail: Not vegan: clam, bacon, meat-sauce and cream pastas, sausages (2026 reviews). No vegan information.

kyoto_pasta_more_kyoto_station.notes: [Pasta · Kyoto Station Hachijo exit, all-day bowls with free upsize] A busy pasta counter inside the station’s Asty mall, open from 7:00 for breakfast to 22:00: clams, Genovese, meat sauce and a tangy thin Napolitan, with large portions at no extra charge. Handy before a Shinkansen; walk-in only; charging points at some seats.

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: an Italian, French and pasta restaurant in Asty Kyoto, opened 7 August 2015. Tabelog also lists Pasta More Ueno (Tokyo) and Kyoto Pastamore at AEON Mall Rinku Sennan (Osaka); the operator is not named in the sources found.

anecdotes.text: An October 2026 diner, picking it by elimination before a Shinkansen, was won over by a thin, tangy Napolitan unlike the usual ketchup kind.
An October 2026 diner chose the regular size, found it smaller than expected, and wished for the free large.
A November 2026 diner found that day’s pasta almost unsalted.

kyoto_rokkakuya_kyoto.notes: [Obanzai izakaya · Kyoto Stn north, oden and obanzai by the piece] A busy basement izakaya near Kyoto Station where you take your shoes off and pick oden from the pot at the counter, alongside Kyoto obanzai, miso dengaku and a surprising tomato-and-yuba gratin, with sake. Book — there is a queue at opening. ¥418 seating charge. Open daily from 17:00.

chef_bio.background: Per the Safari Group site: one of the group’s two brands (六角や and 石庵), with this Kyoto shop listed as the 六角や location. Opened 17 January 2013 (Tabelog).

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 visitor with a 17:00 booking found a line already outside before opening.
An August 2026 visitor called the tomato-and-yuba gratin the biggest surprise of the night.
A July 2026 pair could stay only 90 minutes because of later bookings.

kyoto_toyo_zushi_okazaki.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: soy sauce, red miso soup, fried scallops and fried eggplant (2024–2026 reviews); no allergen information.
kyoto_toyo_zushi_okazaki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish sushi counter; the soup is bonito broth (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_toyo_zushi_okazaki.hours_raw: Tabelog: 11:30–21:00 (last entry 19:30); closed Thursday and Friday per the hours table, though the shop's own note says Wednesday and Friday may close temporarily — phone ahead. No reservations at lunch; book for dinner if possible. A short queue at weekday lunch peaks (November 2025). No service charge — Tabelog, Japanese original 「なし」 (the English page says one may be added). 11 seats: 7 at the counter, 4 at tables. English menu; children and babies welcome (August 2026). No cards; e-money, PayPay and LINE Pay. Non-smoking (smoking spot by the door). Down an alley in Okazaki, 3 min walk from Heian Shrine (Tabelog).
kyoto_toyo_zushi_okazaki.notes: [Sushi · Okazaki, the ¥1,000 tuna bowl near Heian Shrine] A long-established little sushi counter down an alley near Heian Shrine, a lunch refuge from the museum and temple crowds: a limited ¥1,000 tuna nakaochi bowl, anago and seafood bowls and chirashi with a fine bonito-broth soup, and nigiri and sashimi with sake in the evening. Friendly, family-welcoming staff and an English menu. No service charge; no cards.

roles: Owner-chef, not named in a source
chef_bio.background: Tabelog's shop text calls it a long-established sushi shop by Heian Shrine where the owner serves carefully chosen fish at reasonable prices. Reviewers from 2024 to 2026 describe a solid wooden counter, a smiling chef, older regulars, a growing share of foreign visitors and locals collecting maki to take home.

anecdotes.text: March 2026: "A woman, likely a local resident, came to pick up her ordered maki sushi, and it was nice to see the chef smiling as he handed it to her."
May 2024: "Maybe it's just the right portion for the seniors, but it left me wanting a bit more."
August 2026: "I brought my 5-month-old baby, and they kindly allowed us in."

kyoto_daitetsu_shokudo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: house-made wheat noodles (including mochi-wheat), soy-sauce tare, wontons, karaage (2026 reviews).
kyoto_daitetsu_shokudo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: black-pork and chicken broth, niboshi, pork back fat, chashu (2026 reviews).
kyoto_daitetsu_shokudo.hours_raw: Tabelog: 11:30–15:30 and 18:00–20:30; closed Thursday. Occasional "morning ramen" days from 7:00 to 10:00 with a single limited bowl (August and September 2026). No reservations. Counter plus 8 table seats at the back (Tabelog). Tabelog lists no cards, e-money or QR, but PayPay was accepted by October 2026 (review). Large size free on the regular menu (October 2026). On the Sanjo-kai shopping street between Horikawa and Senbon, near Nijo Stn. Opened 21 October 2025 (Tabelog).
kyoto_daitetsu_shokudo.notes: [Ramen · Sanjo-kai arcade, house-made thick noodles] A year-old ramen shop on the Sanjo-kai shopping street whose point is its own hand-kneaded noodles — thick, curly and chewy in shoyu, niboshi and white-shoyu bowls, flat mochi-wheat in the abura soba — with two kinds of chashu and a free large size. One diner did not take to the chilled summer ramen (August 2026); a morning bowl was on the salty side (September 2026). Closed Thursday.

roles: Not named in a source; per reviewers, a new shop from the owner of the ramen shop "Hebinoya"
chef_bio.background: Opened 21 October 2025 (Tabelog). Reviewers in 2026 call it a new venture from the owner of the popular ramen shop "Hebinoya" (August 2026) and the Daitetsu group's fourth shop (September 2026), with a noodle machine in the shop for irregular, hand-kneaded noodles. For its first anniversary in October 2026 it served a collaboration bowl with an Ichijoji tonkotsu shop. Featured on the KBS Kyoto programme "太陽、京都で麺食らう。" broadcast 3 September 2026 (web listing).
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the programme listing, the owner wants to grow a "みんなの味" (everyone's flavour) that the neighbourhood should have.
chef_bio.specialty: House-made thick noodles; niboshi shoyu ramen.

anecdotes.text: August 2026: "This is not a direct spin-off from the popular 'Hebinoya,' but rather a new proposal from the same owner."
August 2026: the chilled ramen — "honestly, the flavor didn't quite match my preferences this time. However, the handmade noodles were impressive."
September 2026, a limited morning bowl called "kishima": "The broth was on the saltier side, the offal was tender."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ダイテツ食堂、ラーメン、中京区三条通神泉苑西入今新在家西町3-1、JR二条駅・二条城前駅、11:30〜15:30・18:00〜20:30、木曜休み、予約不可、奥にテーブル8席、カード・電子マネー・QR不可、2025年10月21日オープン。京都三条会商店街の店舗ページ: 黒豚と鶏のスープ、手打ち式の自家製麺。KBS京都「太陽、京都で麺食らう。#16」(2026年9月3日放送): 店主は地域に「みんなの味」を育てたい。口コミ (2026年1〜10月、英語): 人気店の店主の新しい店、ダイテツグループの4店目、店内の製麺機で手もみ風の不揃いな太麺、醤油ラーメン1,100円、煮干醤油1,150円 (煮干と羅臼昆布、黒豚の背脂)、味玉白醤油1,250円、豚骨醤油、もち小麦の平打ち太麺の油そば (250g・300g)、冷やし煮干ラーメン1,300円、ワンタン3個330円、羅臼昆布の佃煮の〆めし150円、唐揚げとご飯のセット、モモとバラの2種のチャーシュー、並盛と大盛が同じ値段、朝ラーメン (7〜10時) の限定の一杯、1周年に一乗寺の豚骨店とのコラボ、PayPay可に、冷やしは好みでなかったという声、朝の一杯は塩気が強めという声。

kyoto_masuichi_sakaimachi_nishiki.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a beef yakiniku house (Tabelog; reviews).
kyoto_masuichi_sakaimachi_nishiki.hours_raw: Tabelog: Sun–Thu 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); Fri–Sat 17:00–22:30 (last order 22:00); holidays posted on Instagram and the website. Book (phone from 14:00); 2-hour limit for reserved seats, 3 hours in private rooms; online bookings cannot choose seat type. Private-room fee for room bookings — Tabelog, Japanese original 「個室のご予約は個室料いただいております。」 77 seats over two floors, private rooms for 1–8, sunken seating. Non-smoking. Menus in English, Chinese and Korean; children welcome, kids' menu. Cards (incl. UnionPay), PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay; no e-money.
kyoto_masuichi_sakaimachi_nishiki.notes: [Yakiniku · Sakaimachi near Nishiki, Kyoto-styled grill house] A stylish two-floor yakiniku by Nishiki Market from the local Masuichi group: thin-sliced, prettily plated beef, thick-cut tongue, Omi beef yukhoe and good-value courses, with private rooms and multilingual menus. Courses can run small (April 2026); it closes at 22:00 most nights (August 2026). Private-room fee.

roles: Not named in a source; part of the 益市 group (Tabelog)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog, sister shops are 焼き肉家 益市 八条口店 (Kyoto Station), 益市 本店 (Kisshoin), 益市 東店 (near Toji), and three other-named restaurants around Shijo (Yakiniku Soya, Fubito Suuro, Kyoto Meat Dining). Reviewers in 2026 describe a calm, Kyoto-style interior, adults downstairs and families upstairs, energetic and attentive staff, and frosted beer mugs.

anecdotes.text: April 2026: "Overall, the portions were a bit smaller than we expected, so we ended up ordering a little extra, resulting in a bill similar to what we usually pay."
August 2026: for a birthday course "We were able to take home the flower that came with the meat cake," though "the operating hours ended at 10 PM, so we couldn't stay late."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 焼き肉家 益市 堺町錦店、焼肉・ホルモン・居酒屋、中京区堺町錦小路上ル東側、烏丸駅・四条駅から徒歩10分 (地下道14番出口)、日〜木 17:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:30)・金土 17:00〜22:30 (L.O. 22:00)、休みはInstagramとサイトで、電話は14時から、予約席は2時間・個室は3時間、原文で「個室のご予約は個室料いただいております。」、77席、個室 (1〜8名)、掘りごたつ、禁煙、英語・中国語・韓国語のメニュー、子供可・子供メニュー、カード・PayPay・Alipay・WeChat Pay可、電子マネー不可、姉妹店は益市 八条口店・本店 (吉祥院)・東店 (東寺近く)・焼肉 soya、Fubito Suuro、Kyoto Meat Dining。口コミ (2025年3月〜2026年8月、英語): 京都らしい店内と器、薄切りの肉、近江牛のユッケ、厚切りタン、ハラミ、生で食べられるほどのロース、厚切りのマルチョウ、極みコースとプレミアムコース、肉ケーキ、冷麺、コースの量が少なめという声、22時で閉まるのが残念という声。

cultural_comfort.note: Menus in English, Chinese and Korean; private-room fee.

kyoto_sushi_no_musashi_hachijo.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: soy sauce, creative and fried sushi, yuba sweets (Tabelog; 2026 reviews); no allergen information.
kyoto_sushi_no_musashi_hachijo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish conveyor-belt sushi shop (Tabelog).
kyoto_sushi_no_musashi_hachijo.hours_raw: Tabelog: daily 10:30–21:45 (last entry 21:20, last order 21:30); open all year. Take-away 9:00–21:45, bookable for same-day pickup from an hour ahead (official site). No reservations; queues at peak, quick turnover (2026 reviews). 31 seats; non-smoking; wheelchair access; children welcome. Japanese and English menus; order from the chefs as well as off the belt (June 2026). Cards, transit IC and e-money, QR (PayPay, Alipay, WeChat Pay). In Asty Road (Kyoto omotenashi-koji), 1 min from the Hachijo Exit Shinkansen gates.
kyoto_sushi_no_musashi_hachijo.notes: [Conveyor sushi · Kyoto Station Hachijo Exit, a local since 1977] The station branch of Kyoto's own Kawaramachi-Sanjo conveyor-belt sushi, by the Shinkansen gates: chef-made plates from ¥146, straw-seared bonito, hamo oshi-zushi in season, and take-away boxes for the train, open 10:30 to 21:45 every day. Expect queues and a mostly tourist crowd; some found it ordinary for the price (July–August 2026), and popular fish sells out late (June 2026).

roles: Not named in a source; branch of 寿しのむさし (official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site, 寿しのむさし opened in 1977 at Kawaramachi-Sanjo and has run for over forty years, particular about fish, rice, vinegar, tea, soy sauce, wasabi and nori; current shops are the Sanjo main shop, this Hachijo Exit shop, and a take-away-only shop at Kamihorikawa. Reviewers in 2026 describe sushi on the belt plus orders straight to the chefs, quick service, and a crowd that is about half foreign visitors.
chef_bio.philosophy: From the site: "真心も 美味しさも 特上です" (sincerity and flavour, both top grade).

anecdotes.text: June 2026: "When I visited about an hour before the last order, I found that items like hamachi and aji were sold out."
July 2026: "I couldn't understand what this restaurant's appeal was… While it is indeed affordable, there are also some expensive items, so be cautious."
July 2026: a former regular of the Sanjo main shop "usually avoid[s] this location because it's always crowded."

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 京都の寿しのむさし、職人が握る地魚の回転寿司、1977年に京都の河原町三条で開店、四十余年、ネタ・米・酢・お茶・醤油・わさび・海苔・清潔さ・気配りにこだわる、店舗は三条本店・京都駅八条口店・上堀川店 (ネット予約テイクアウト受取専用)、京都駅八条口店限定のはも姿寿司の予約、持ち帰りは当日最短1時間後の予約可。食べログ: 寿しのむさし 京都駅八条口店、回転寿司、下京区東塩小路高倉町8-3 JR京都駅構内アスティ1F、新幹線側の八条口から徒歩1分、毎日 10:30〜21:45 (最終入店21:20、L.O. 21:30)、持ち帰り9:00〜21:45、年中無休、予約不可、31席、禁煙、車椅子可、カード・電子マネー・QR可、常時約50種、1皿146円 (税抜) から、鱧の押し寿司、京ゆばのスイーツ。口コミ (2026年5〜9月、英語): 藁焼きの鰹、トロ、玉子、馬刺し、日本語と英語のメニュー、職人に直接注文、外国の客が半分ほど、行列、遅い時間は品切れ、普通の回転寿司で割高な皿もという声。

cultural_comfort.note: English menu; conveyor belt plus ordering from the chefs.

existence.note: Official site lists the shop; Tabelog reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_alkaa_hachijo.gf_detail: Ask. A wine bar with small plates and sweets — salami, charcuterie, quiche, gougères, canelés, financiers, Basque cheesecake, salt sablés; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_alkaa_hachijo.vegan_detail: Ask. Wine is the focus; the food is charcuterie, cheese-based and baked sweets, and nothing plant-based is described (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_alkaa_hachijo.hours_raw: Monday–Thursday, Saturday and Sunday 15:00–24:00; Friday 18:00–24:00; days off vary — check Instagram; after a day off it opens 18:00–24:00 (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; a reservation is advisable (Tabelog; June 2025). Charge ¥500 including tax (Tabelog, original チャージ料500円（税込）). Cards, QUICPay, PayPay and Rakuten Pay (Tabelog). 15 seats: a counter downstairs and a private room upstairs (Tabelog; November 2025, April 2026). Wine is the only drink served, and the bar asks people who do not drink alcohol not to visit; guests wearing strong perfume may be refused entry (Tabelog). Two minutes on foot from the Hachijo exit of Kyoto Station (Tabelog).
kyoto_alkaa_hachijo.notes: [Wine bar · Kyoto Station Hachijo exit, natural wine and canelés] A calm, stylish wine bar two minutes from the Shinkansen side of Kyoto Station, open from 15:00 most days: natural and French wines by the glass, salami and charcuterie, and sweets such as canelés and Basque cheesecake from the owner’s wife’s pastry shop. Wine only — non-drinkers are asked not to come; ¥500 charge.

chef_bio.background: A five-time regular noted the bar’s fourth anniversary in April 2026, and in June 2025 found the master seemingly running the evenings alone; a December 2025 visitor also thought the master handled everything single-handedly. The sweets come from atelier ALKAA, run by the owner’s wife (May 2025), whose canelés another reviewer praised (November 2025). An April 2026 visitor heard the floor had been rebuilt to make a wine cellar.
chef_bio.specialty: Natural and French wine by the glass; canelés.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 visitor, back after three years, drinks here until the last minute before the Shinkansen — the bar is that close to the platforms.
An April 2026 group of four phoned at about 19:30 and got the upstairs private room.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: ALKAA、ワインバー、南区東九条西山王町15-7、京都駅八条口から徒歩2分、月〜木・土・日 15:00〜24:00、金 18:00〜24:00、定休日はインスタグラムで告知、休みの翌日は18:00〜24:00、予約可、チャージ料500円 (税込)、カード可、15席、ワイン以外の飲み物はなく、お酒を飲めない方の来店は遠慮してもらう、強い香水は入店を断ることがある。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 自然派とフランスのワインをグラスで1,300〜1,400円ほど、サラミ3種1,000円、カヌレ300円、グジェール、塩チョコのフィナンシェ、バスクチーズケーキ、シャルキュトリー、キッシュ、塩サブレ、甘味は店主の妻の atelier ALKAA から、2階に個室、4周年 (2026年4月)。

cultural_comfort.note: Wine only — non-drinkers are asked not to come; no strong perfume; ¥500 charge.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through August 2026.

kyoto_rondo_miyako_hachijo.gf_detail: Ask. Wheat is one of the allergens the restaurant marks on each dish’s name card, so wheat-containing dishes can be spotted; but everything is cooked in one kitchen with shared utensils, trace contamination is possible, and no substitute dishes are made (Tabelog). The official site asks guests with food allergies to say so in advance.
kyoto_rondo_miyako_hachijo.vegan_detail: Ask. The lunch buffet is heavy on vegetables (July and October 2026) and Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but no vegan dish is described.
kyoto_rondo_miyako_hachijo.hours_raw: Lunch 11:30–15:00 (L.O. courses and sets 13:30, others 14:30); dinner 17:00–22:00 (L.O. courses, sets and gozen 20:30, others 21:00); café time 15:00–17:00 on Saturdays, Sundays and holidays only (official site). Breakfast 6:30–9:00 — days vary, ask the staff (official site). Open year-round (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, without seat choice (Tabelog). Service charge included in prices (Tabelog, original サービス料は料金に含む). Cards and QR payments; no e-money (Tabelog). 140 seats, ground floor of the main building (official site). Hotel parking free for 2 hours with ¥2,000 spent, 3 hours with ¥3,000 (Tabelog). Two minutes on foot from the Hachijo exit of Kyoto Station (Tabelog).
kyoto_rondo_miyako_hachijo.notes: [Hotel dining · Kyoto Station Hachijo exit, lunch buffet with a main] The big all-day restaurant of Miyako Hotel Kyoto Hachijo, two minutes from the station: a half-buffet lunch of salads, soups and desserts with a choice of main (¥4,900), set courses with pasta and roast beef, breakfast buffets and cakes. Attentive hotel service and no rush to leave. Service included.

chef_bio.background: The restaurant of Miyako Hotel Kyoto Hachijo (Tabelog; official site). Tabelog’s invoice number T8010003050331 is registered to 合同会社京都八条ホテルアセット, Tokyo (NTA register). The official site mentions only “the Rondo chef”.
chef_bio.specialty: Lunch choice buffet with a main dish.

anecdotes.text: An August 2026 family of three generations chose a course over the buffet; the ¥1,900 kids’ meal was bigger than expected.
A May 2026 guest who found the lunch on Ozmall stayed from 11:30 to 15:00 with no time limit.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: ダイニングカフェ&バー「ロンド」、140席・本館1F、朝食6:30〜9:00 (営業日は日によって異なる)、ランチ11:30〜15:00、ディナー17:00〜22:00、カフェタイム15:00〜17:00 (土日祝のみ)、和洋朝食ブッフェ4,000円 (宿泊客3,300円)、小学生2,000円、アメリカンブレックファスト4,000円、ランチチョイスブッフェ ERANDE、食物アレルギーは予め申し出を。食べログ: 洋食・カフェ・ケーキ、南区西九条院町17 都ホテル京都八条 1F、京都駅八条口から徒歩2分、年中無休、予約可 (席の指定不可)、サービス料は料金に含む、カード可、電子マネー不可、適格請求書 T8010003050331 (合同会社京都八条ホテルアセット)、ERANDE 4,900円、ロンドランチコース5,500円、特定原材料の8品目 (9月から9品目) を料理の札に表示、同じ厨房と調理器具を使うため混入の可能性あり、代替メニューはない。口コミ (2026年、英語): 野菜の多いブッフェ、ミニパンケーキの機械、月替わりのパスタ、お子様ランチ1,900円、時間制限なしのランチ、ホテルの丁寧なサービス、朝食ブッフェ。

cultural_comfort.note: Hotel restaurant; reservations online; allergen cards on the buffet.

gf_cross_contamination: All dishes are made in the same kitchen with the same utensils and cleaning equipment as allergen-containing dishes; trace contamination is possible (Tabelog).
staff_allergy_handling: Eight (from September, nine) specified allergens, including wheat, are shown on each dish’s name card; other allergies are not handled and no substitute dishes are made (Tabelog). Tell the restaurant in advance (official site).

kyoto_shokudo_mankichi.gf_detail: Ask. Sushi and Japanese dishes — sashimi, nigiri, tempura, miso-grilled fish, pork kakuni, tsukune; soy sauce and miso are not described (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_shokudo_mankichi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish-and-sushi kitchen; the course soup is made with Rishiri kombu and honkarebushi (bonito) dashi (Tabelog).
kyoto_shokudo_mankichi.hours_raw: Tuesday–Sunday and holidays 17:00–23:00 (L.O. food 22:00, drinks 22:30); closed Monday (Tabelog). Reservations accepted; one order per person; seat-only bookings and à la carte on the day also possible (Tabelog). Junior-high age and older only (Tabelog). Cards, e-money and QR payments (Tabelog). 16 seats, counter and tables; private hire for up to 20 (Tabelog). Opened 29 February 2024 (Tabelog). About 7–8 min on foot from the Hachijo exit of Kyoto Station (Tabelog; October 2026).
kyoto_shokudo_mankichi.notes: [Sushi and Japanese · near the Hachijo exit, kaiseki-trained chef] A small counter south of Kyoto Station where a chef with three decades in kaiseki serves ¥8,800 sushi or Japanese courses — the mid-course soup is made in front of you — plus à la carte sashimi, grilled fish and sake. Adults and teens only; closed Monday. Part of the local らくちん restaurant group.

chef_bio.background: Tabelog says the chef trained for 30 years in a kaiseki restaurant and makes the course dashi personally. Tabelog’s website link is the company page of 有限会社らくちん, and the invoice number T5130002022652 is registered to 有限会社らくちん (NTA register); the company page lists 11 shops (8 run directly, 3 franchised), led by 大衆酒場フレンチマン, with izakaya, yakiniku, yakitori, French and Thai restaurants, under representative director 渡辺 哲也. Reviewers praise the chef’s timing (August 2025, January 2026) and the friendly staff (December 2025).
chef_bio.specialty: Sushi with Japanese course dishes; seasonal soup.

anecdotes.text: An October 2025 birthday table got a surprise birthday plate; the reviewer called the chef the best.
An October 2026 guest filled up on sashimi, soft roe, karasumi and crab and never got to the sushi.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 食道 萬きち、寿司・日本料理・海鮮、南区東九条西山王町1-5、京都駅八条口から徒歩7分、火〜日・祝 17:00〜23:00 (L.O.料理22:00、ドリンク22:30)、月曜定休、予約可、1人1オーダー、中学生以上、カード可、16席、貸切20名まで、2024年2月29日オープン、懐石で30年修業した料理人、萬きち日本料理コース14品8,800円 (利尻昆布と本枯節の出汁)、寿司と一品のコース15品8,800円、Buta Otoko とのコラボの極みコース17,600円、適格請求書 T5130002022652 (有限会社らくちん)。会社概要: 有限会社らくちん、代表取締役 渡辺 哲也、11店舗 (直営8、FC3)、大衆酒場フレンチマンほか。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 刺身、握り、鮎の天ぷら、鰆の味噌焼き、つくね、カキフライ、豚の角煮、春巻き、白子、からすみ、日本酒。

cultural_comfort.note: Counter sushi; junior-high age and older only; one order per person.

kyoto_tori_shige_mibu.gf_detail: Ask. Yakitori with salt or sauce, chicken mizutaki hot pot, oyakodon, karaage and chicken cutlet; seasonings are not described (official site; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_tori_shige_mibu.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken restaurant — yakitori, chicken-bone mizutaki broth, oyakodon in dashi (official site; reviews).
kyoto_tori_shige_mibu.hours_raw: 17:30–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); closed Sundays and Mondays, Mondays even on holidays (Tabelog; official site). Chicken mizutaki needs a reservation by the day before and is served from November to the end of March; the milky chicken soup is available all year (Tabelog; official site). Yakitori orders: at least two skewers of each kind for parties of two or more (official site). Cards, e-money and QR payments (Tabelog). 15 seats: 7 at the counter, 8 on sofas (Tabelog). Children welcome, with one free soft drink each up to high-school age (Tabelog). About 6 min on foot from JR Tambaguchi Station (Tabelog).
kyoto_tori_shige_mibu.notes: [Yakitori and mizutaki · Mibu, since 1973] A homey 15-seat chicken restaurant in a residential street, run by a friendly couple: ¥220 yakitori skewers, a much-praised oyakodon, and from November a milky chicken mizutaki hot pot (book the day before) finished with egg zosui. Family-friendly and non-smoking; closed Sunday and Monday.

chef_bio.background: The official site says the restaurant was founded in Kyoto in 1973 (Showa 48). Tabelog’s invoice number T8810019048857 is registered to the individual 松尾 茂 (NTA register). Reviewers describe a family-run shop with a warm hostess (May 2024), welcomed by “a very pleasant couple running the restaurant” (May 2025) and “the couple running the restaurant” who were friendly (November 2025); a December 2025 visitor found “both the chef and the owner incredibly kind”.

anecdotes.text: A November 2025 visitor, there near closing time, was told to take as long as needed anyway.
A November 2026 family with children were given snacks on the way out.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト: 鳥茂、昭和48年に京都で創業、17:30〜22:00 (L.O.21:30)、日曜・月曜定休、焼き鳥は1本220円 (2名様より1種類につき2本以上)、親子丼850円、水炊きコース6,000円、鶏の水炊き (雑炊付き) 1人前4,700円・要予約、焼き鳥セット2,000円 (お通し、おまかせ5本、生ビール)、唐揚げ830円、手羽塩焼き770円、玉子焼き700円。食べログ: 焼き鳥・親子丼・水炊き、中京区壬生松原町40-39、JR丹波口駅から徒歩6分、カード可、15席 (カウンター7、ソファ8)、子どもにソフトドリンク1杯サービス、水炊きは11月から3月末まで・前日までの予約制、白湯スープは通年、適格請求書 T8810019048857 (松尾 茂)。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 夫婦で営む店、焼き鳥、Daisen の鶏、チキンカツ、納豆オムレツ、鴨ロース、だし巻き、水炊きのコース、雑炊。

cultural_comfort.note: Neighbourhood chicken restaurant; book mizutaki the day before; families welcome.

existence.note: Official site and Tabelog; reviews dated through November 2026.
